The original EP, 3rd in the Read & Burn series, and the one not compiled on to the Send album, was the last non-historic release by the original Wire line up of Colin Newman, Graham Lewis, Bruce Gilbert & Robert Grey and has never been properly released on vinyl. releases.title: Live At Revolution Hall (RSD Edition)
releases.label: 4AD
releases.details: Anfang 2025 veröffentlichte Big-Thief-Songwriterin Adrianne Lenker ein 120-minütiges, 43-Track umfassendes, intimes Live-Album mit dem Titel Live at Revolution Hall, ein eindringliches klangliches Dokument, das über drei Aufführungstage hinweg zusammengestellt wurde. Nun wird das Album zum allerersten Mal auf Standard-Schwarzem Vinyl gepresst, exklusiv für den Record Store Day 2026. Mit eingeflochtenen Soundbites von begeistertem Applaus und Publikumsgesprächen führt Produzent Andrew Sarlo die Zuhörer*innen direkt an die Bühne, wo Lenker und ihre Band (darunter Josefin Runsteen und Nick Hakim) ein Set aus tiefgründigen Songs, Fan-Favoriten (wie „not a lot, just forever“ und „anything“) und unveröffentlichten Juwelen (darunter „oldest“ und „happiness“) präsentieren – dargeboten mit funkelnden Tastenklängen, Gänsehaut erzeugenden Cello-Passagen und Lenkers emotional berührendem Gesang. Über die Veröffentlichung sagt Lenker: „Hier ist ein kleines Licht in einem Glas, eine Momentaufnahme des Geistes aller Shows, die ich je gespielt habe und je spielen werde. Die Musik ist lebendig, und die Magie der Aufnahme erlaubt es uns, diesem Funken jederzeit und überall nahe zu sein – und wenn wir wollen, immer und immer wieder.“

releases.title: Sponges Of Experience
releases.label: Born Losers Records
releases.details:
This album was written over the 4-day weekend of Memorial Day, 2025. It was a challenge to myself: when I was a wee teenager I heard Elvis Costello mention on some talk show (I’ve long forgotten which) that he could write an album over a weekend. It was on off-hand remark, a throw away line as he was promoting something or other. A budding songwriter myself, I was curious if I could pull off something of the sort.
 Fast forward to 35 odd years later, I decided to give it a shot. I offered myself FOUR days rather than just the two, and perhaps that’s a cheat, but since it was Memorial Day weekend I decided to allow it. As it turned out, I absolutely needed those extra two days. The other rules were simple: I just needed to write a complete composition and completed lyrics for enough songs to fill an album. At least… eight songs, though I would’ve been disappointed with just eight. I kept pushing myself to write as much as possible, as I wanted to have enough songs to be able to weed out one or two of the crappier contributions. All of the additional arrangements you hear were written and recorded after the fact, casually over the remaining year, no rush nor rules on those parameters.

releases.title: Hung Up On You / One Day (Live)
releases.label: Nettwerk Music Group
releases.details:
For the first time ever, Tate McRae’s “Hung Up On You” arrives on 7″ vinyl—paired with a special live recording of her breakout single “One Day,” captured at YouTube Space NYC in 2020.
 From her early days as a So You Think You Can Dance finalist to becoming one of the defining voices of modern pop, the Canadian singer, songwriter, and dancer has carved out a singular path. With over 8 billion career streams, a #1 Billboard 200 album (‚So Close to What‘, 2025), and chart-dominating singles like “You Broke Me First,” “Greedy,” and “Sports Car,” McRae has proven herself as both a powerhouse vocalist and an evocative storyteller. Named in TIME100 Next’s list for 2025, she’s earned acclaim for blending raw vulnerability with the effortless lustre of a natural born performer.
 Pressed on limited neon violet vinyl, this exclusive RSD 7” captures both sides of McRae’s artistry—the sleek studio precision of “Hung Up On You” and the heartfelt intimacy of “One Day.” A must-have collector’s piece from one of pop’s brightest stars.

releases.details: „The Great Western was James Dean Bradfield’s first solo offering, originally released in 2006. The Manic Street Preachers front man took the opportunity of a band hiatus to produce a melodic, demonstrative, power-pop album that is every bit as expansive and anthemic as any other Manics’ album. Long deleted and much sought after, this limited edition orange marble vinyl edition is a fitting way to mark its 20th anniversary. „

releases.title: Live A L’Olympia
releases.format: 2LP – black vinyl first time on vinyl / documentary in Feb
releases.label: SME US
releases.details: This live album captures Jeff Buckley and band across two nights in Paris July 6th & 7th during his 1995 European tour in support of the release of his Grace album. Captured at the legendary Olympia, it found Buckley before a rapturous French crowd performing half of the songs from his beloved debut album ( including favorites like “Lover, You Should Have Come Over” and “Hallelujah”) plus covers as varied as the MC5’s “Kick Out The Jams,” a Led Zeppelin parody and songs made famous by Nina Simone and Edith Piaf. In addition, the album features an additional live performance of Buckley and Alim Qasimov in a competitive Qawwali singing duet from a festival of sacred music also captured that year in France. Originally released in 2001, this marks the album’s first time on vinyl exclusively for Record Store Day.

releases.title: Sweet Tea (25th Anniversary)
releases.label: SME UK
releases.details: „Due to celebrate his 90th birthday in July 2026, Buddy Guy is the last of the great Chicago bluesmen that were such an indelible influence on the biggest guitarists in rock – Jimi Hendrix, Jimmy Page, Eric Clapton, Keith Richards and many others. Born in Louisiana, he moved to Chicago in 1957 and worked with legends such as Muddy Waters, Howlin’ Wolf and Little Walter at Chess Records, the label that issued his first album in 1968. At the dawn of the 1990s Buddy signed with Silvertone Records, with whom he has enjoyed a long and fruitful association over the last thirty years and more than a dozen albums. One of these is Sweet Tea (2001), something of a classic in his canon, presented here on coloured (well, crystal clear) vinyl for the first time to celebrate its 25th anniversary. Cut at the studio of the same name in Mississippi, it features a raw, back to basics approach with plenty of extended, heavy jams and on which Buddy really burns. Nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Contemporary Blues Album, highlights include four songs by the late Junior Kimbrough, a fellow blues stylist from the Southern USA, including the acoustic confessional ‘Done Got Old’ and a powerful take on Lowell Fulson’s legendary ‘Tramp’.“

releases.title: To All New Arrivals
releases.label: SME UK
releases.details: „Something of a slow burner, Faithless’ fifth album was issued in 2006 and although it didn’t replicate the chart performance of its predecessor, No Roots (which reached Number One), it is also now a UK gold seller. An ambitious, heartfelt and inventive blend of breakbeat, house, down-tempo and synth-pop material, which showcases the group’s usual high production standards, the album’s title was inspired by the birth of two babies to band members Rollo and Sister Bliss and was endorsed by Maxi Jazz due to his Buddhist faith and the fact that his parents had been new arrivals to the UK in the 1950s. Guest vocals are provided by, among others, Cat Power, Dido and Robert Smith, who appears on the brilliant ‘Spiders, Crocodiles & Kryptonite’, which samples The Cure’s much-loved ‘Lullaby’. Pressed as a single disc in tiny numbers upon initial release, this 20th anniversary version, the first ever colour pressing, was cut to lacquer as a 2LP set by its original mastering engineer, Miles Showell, at Abbey Road Studios.“

releases.title: The Original Fleetwood Mac
releases.label: SME UK
releases.details: „Led by the brilliant, London-born guitarist and songwriter Peter Green (1946-2020), Fleetwood Mac (initially Peter Green’s Fleetwood Mac) formed in 1967 after Green left John Mayall’s Bluesbreakers. Recruiting Mick Fleetwood and John McVie, with whom he had played in Mayall’s band, as well as fellow guitarist Jeremy Spencer (and in 1968 adding the talented Danny Kirwan), they signed to Mike Vernon’s Blue Horizon label and instantly became a major presence on the UK blues-rock scene, producing a remarkable run of classy records including ‘Black Magic Woman’, ‘Need Your Love So Bad’, ‘Albatross’ and ‘Oh Well (Parts 1 and 2)’, mostly written by Green. The initial phase of this storied band had run its course by 1970, and in May the following year The Original Fleetwood Mac was issued. It featured unreleased masters and outtakes from their 1967-8 sessions, including the blistering instrumental ‘Fleetwood Mac’ among many other gems. Remastered and expanded with seven previously unreleased tracks and notes by Vernon, the album was reissued in 2004, and it is this 19-track version, cut to lacquer by Alex Wharton at Abbey Road Studios, that makes its vinyl debut for Record Store Day. James Dean Bradfield – The Great Western – 19958413271 The Great Western was James Dean Bradfield’s first solo offering, originally released in 2006. Long deleted and much sought after, this vinyl edition is the first time the album has been available on colour vinyl, a fitting way to mark its 20th anniversary.“

releases.title: Northern Soul
releases.label: SME UK
releases.details: „Featuring the singles ‘Colour My Life’, ‘How Can I Love You More’ (the band’s first top ten hit), ‘Excited’ and ‘Someday’, M People’s debut album was issued in 1992 on Deconstruction Records. It was the early days of a remarkably creative period for electronic and dance music in the UK, during which DJ-led acts began to make an indelible mark, and the songs and production of Mike Pickering (one of the original DJs at Manchester’s The Haçienda) and Paul Heard, coupled with the highly distinctive vocals of Heather Small, were in the vanguard of this success. By mid-decade, the group were really cooking – with hits across the Atlantic and a Mercury Music Prize in the bag for their second album Elegant Slumming – and Northern Soul was reissued with an adjusted tracklisting, before being remastered and expanded ten years later. It is this 2005, 15-track remaster, spread over two discs, that is being made available on vinyl for the first time.“

Originally released as a digital only album in 2023 this limited edition green marble vinyl edition is the first very first time it has been released as a physical product. Wire says Intimism is “as me as me can be – a distillation of my purest indie fantasies, a place where all those broken lists of regret have found themselves realigned. I found a musical and lyrical language I could call my own. A landscape of mundane miracles, interior monologues and lacerating self loathing. As the song says: ‘I am an -ist / I am an -ism / a lifelong affair with tunnel vision”.“

This Big Apple Red colored 2LP live record comes with a booklet and never-before-seen drafts of the tour production and inspiration behind the tour creative that immerses listeners in the spellbinding performance that has made Laufey’s live show a global phenomenon.

releases.title: Extra Virgin (2LP)
releases.label: SME UK
releases.details: „Purveyors of a judicious blend of hip hop production, synth-based electronica and pop songwriting, Olive were formed by former Durutti Column and Simply Red multi-instrumentalist Tim Kellett, singer Ruth-Ann Boyle and beat-master Robin Taylor-Firth, best known for his work with Nightmares on Wax. They enjoyed a monster hit in 1997 with the irresistible drum and bass floater ‘You’re Not Alone’. The Ivor Novello award winning chart-topper was taken from their accomplished debut album, Extra Virgin, which had been issued the previous year and is now being celebrated on its 30th anniversary with, naturally, an olive-coloured reissue featuring audio remastered from the original tape sources at AIR Studios by Kellett and Henry Rudkins. America’s biggest weekly entertainment magazine, People, described the album as “a bittersweet delight,” with particular praise for Ruth-Ann’s honied vocals, and it’s hard to argue as they beautifully offset the icy production and sometimes dark subject matter of the songs.“

Spanning over three hours of powerhouse performances in front of 35,000 people, this 5LP set features Springsteen at his dynamic best, backed by the legendary E Street Band. Spanning Springsteen’s iconic catalog, this record includes hits such as „Thunder Road“ and „Dancing in the Dark,“ plus songs that Springsteen wrote just down the road from this stage, including „Blinded By The Light“ and „Growin‘ Up.“

releases.title: Nite Flights
releases.label: SME US
releases.details: A first ever color pressing for the sixth and final studio album by the Walker Brothers, initially released in July 1978, which has been cut to lacquer from the original ¼ inch master tapes. The last of their three albums issued on GTO Records, unlike its predecessors it was made up entirely of original songs and, though it was largely ignored by the public upon release, it has long since been reappraised as something of a lost classic. Indeed, the four tracks written by Scott Walker on side one are now widely regarded as some of his finest compositions, foreshadowing his re-emergence as an avant-garde artist in the mid-80s and influencing the work of Japan, Radiohead, Pulp and others. The experimental, string-laden single ‘The Electrician’ is particularly noteworthy; a remarkable piece that Midge Ure has claimed was the inspiration for the Ultravox smash ‘Vienna’. And while Davie Bowie’s Heroes (1977) was brought to the studio by Scott as a creative reference, Bowie was equally taken by Nite Flights, listening to it while creating The Lodger (1979) and covering the title track in 1993 for his Black Tie White Noise album. 30 years after its release, UNCUT scribe Chris Roberts called Nite Flights, “one of the most important works of its time“, praising the synergy of the trio’s individual styles. Though they worked independently, the album has a coherence that belies the fact it even the band members described it as more like three miniature solo efforts than a true group album.

This 2LP set, pressed exclusively for Record Store Day, features 21 unforgettable tracks, including classics like „I Left My Heart in San Francisco“, „Fly Me to the Moon“, and „Steppin’ Out With My Baby“.

releases.details: „Purveying short, sharp, perfectly formed bursts of rock energy that immediately drew favourable comparisons with groups like The Ramones and The Strokes, The Vaccine’s debut album, What Did You Expect From The Vaccines?, was one of the most thrilling indie rock releases of the last 20 years and the most successful debut release of 2011, with UK sales of over 500,000 units to date. In 2020, the seven B-sides from the album’s singles were compiled into a digital-only collection featuring fan favourites like ‘We’re Happening’ and ‘Tiger Blood’. And the following year the 10-track demos collection hit digital platforms, showcasing rough and ready, reverb-heavy versions of the album tracks and B-sides, alongside unreleased songs like ‘Grow Your Hair Out Long’. Neither release has made onto vinyl previously and we are delighted to combine both into one potent Record Store Day exclusive.“

releases.details: Dive into the second chapter of uncompromising sonic exploration with Metal Machine Music: Power to Consume, Vol. 2, a Record Store Day 2026 exclusive Although this may be the final edition (or is it?) of the Metal Machine Music: Power to Consume series, these artists and their accompanying auditory hallucinations are a proclamation that noise, industrial and experimental sounds, as well as the spirit of Lou Reed, continue to build upon themselves and are infinite. This time around, the purveyors of maximalist sounds are even more diverse featuring: Merzbow, Masonna, Pod Blotz, Lydia Lunch, Blixa Bargeld, EROS, Martin Rev, Moonbeam Terror…and Emil Beaulieau (of RRRecords). Dive in ears first and play this loud! inspired by Lou Reed’s groundbreaking 1975 noise opus. This curated compilation assembles a formidable lineup of avant-garde artists pushing the boundaries of distortion, feedback, and raw electronic texture.Featuring contributions from Emil Beaulieau, Lydia Lunch, Moonbeam Terror, Eros, Blixa Bargeld, Pod Blutz, Martin Rev, Merzbow, and Masonna.

releases.title: Emotional (Live) [RSD 2026 EX]
releases.format: Limited 1 x140g 12″ Gold vinyl album. RSD 2026.
releases.label: WMCE
releases.details:
The year was 1986, and Falco was at the center of the musical universe. Following the unprecedented global explosion of „Rock Me Amadeus,“ his fourth studio album, Emotional, solidified his status as an international icon. The ensuing „Emotional World Tour“ was more than just a series of concerts; it was a victory lap for an artist who blended pop brilliance with a sharp, theatrical edge.
 
 To mark the 40th anniversary of this landmark era, Falco – Emotional (Live) is being released for the first time on vinyl. This curated set captures the essence of his legendary performance at Berlin’s Eissporthalle on October 27, 1986. For decades, parts of these recordings were considered lost to time. Now, they return to the spotlight, featuring definitive live versions of hits like „The Sound of Musik,“ „Coming Home (Jeanny Part 2),“ and the soul-stirring title track „Emotional.“
 
 This Record Store Day 2026 exclusive has been meticulously mastered for the format to ensure every nuance of Falco’s commanding vocal performance is preserved. Pressed on limited gold vinyl and housed in a deluxe gatefold jacket, this release serves as both a celebration of a classic album and a tribute to the „Falcon’s“ enduring legacy as a visionary of pop.

releases.title: Lost in Sound
releases.label: Charlie Parker Records
releases.details: „This record sees its first official vinyl reissue in over five decades. A stereo edition pressing on limited edition heavyweight color vinyl with an expanded gatefold sleeve. Yusef Lateef needs little introduction: a multi-instrumentalist and jazz visionary who blended global sounds with spiritual depth. ‚Lost in Sound‘ is one of his earlier titles, and his only record for the Charlie Parker label. It was recorded in New York – August 14, 1961 – 65 years ago. Lateef focuses solely on tenor saxophone here as he moved away from hard-bop toward more exploratory horizons. The sides feature a lesser-known but remarkably cohesive quintet: Vincent Pitts (trumpet), John Harman (piano), Ray McKinny (bass), and Clifford Jarvis or George Scott (drums). The eight-track set blends soulful swing with post-bop, highlighted by Pitts’ originals “Soul Blues” and “Trudy’s Delight,” alongside a vibrant take on Charlie Parker’s “Dexterity.” A collectors edition exclusively for Record Store Day 2026.“

releases.title: Lady Be Good: Live in Europe With the Birdland All-Stars
releases.label: Unique Jazz
releases.details: „The 1956 Europen sessions with Miles Davis and the Birdland All Stars lineup (with Lester Young and MJQ) see their 70th anniversary. New and exclusive vinyl only pressings will be available for RSD26 on heavweight colour edition gatefold LPs. Miles Davis broke up his ‘First Great Quintet’ in 1956 as a consequence of John Coltrane’s severe heroin addiction. Miles, having recovered from his own addiction, fired Coltrane and drummer Philly Joe Jones in March 1956 due to their struggles with the drug. At the same time Miles was struggling with the racial tensions and prejudice he suffered in the U.S., as well as his growing infamy and bad reputation domestically. Miles had previously toured Paris in 1949 and relished the experience of performing in front of a more accepting audience. In order to advance his career and enjoy some respite from his turbulent home, Miles accepted an offer to tour Europe with a new group of musicians. They were named the ‘Birdland All Stars’, and included Lester Young, the Modern Jazz Quartet, and many other top-tier jazzmen. These recordings are the only ones in history to feature both Miles and Lester, and took place over several concerts from the tour.“

releases.title: Showcase
releases.label: Observer / Prestige Elite
releases.details: „Limited edition numbered pressings on heavyweight color vinyl, exclusive for RSD26. Freddie McGregor’s Showcase (1981), produced by roots reggae icon Winston “Niney” Holness, is a product of the era’s vocal-and-dub “showcase” format and a key release from one of Jamaica’s most iconic voices. Featuring dub-forward production and a seamless blend of Lovers Rock and conscious roots material, the album bridges the sound of 1970s Kingston with the more melodic direction that would carry McGregor into international success with ‘Big Ship’ the following year. This is the first official reissue in four decades and an essential record of McGregor’s early solo era. „

releases.title: The 1966 Manchester Sessions – Live at Club 43
releases.label: Jazz Rewind (Hindsight)
releases.details: „Heavyweight Black Vinyl Edition with Numbered Gatefold Artwork! Mark Murphy’s time in the UK during the 1960s played a pivotal role in shaping British jazz. The renowned American vocalist moved to London in 1963, quickly establishing himself on the scene with frequent performances at iconic venues such as Ronnie Scott’s Club and regular appearances on BBC Radio. Manchester’s music circuit was also a thriving centre for jazz during the sixties, hosting a mix of prestigious American and British acts. Among its standout venues, the jazz-inspired bar Club 43 became a hub for intimate concerts, particularly for those US musicians doing their European tours, and included this memorable series of shows by Mark Murphy in 1966. Over six decades later, these previously unheard recordings of Murphy at Club 43 have been unearthed from the venue archives and are set for a limited edition double LP release. For collectors and scat enthusiasts alike, this is a rare chance to own a first – and only – pressing of a true jazz vocal master, presented on heavyweight black edition vinyl with numbered gatefold artwork.“

releases.title: French Dogs EP
releases.label: Ciao Ketchup
releases.details: „12” EP Black Vinyl – Individually hand-numbered on back sleeve FIRST TIME ON VINYL / RSD 2026 EXCLUSIVE “A classic sound.” – John Kennedy, Radio X “I love ‘Treasure’ from French Dogs.” – Jess Iszatt, BBC Introducing (Radio 1 / BBC London) Following their explosive arrival on the scene last year, London’s French Dogs make their highly anticipated debut on wax for Record Store Day 2026. This 12” EP is a four-track snapshot of late nights and restless hearts, capturing the unfiltered energy that has already ignited the UK indie scene. Since its digital launch on December 5th, the French Dogs EP has secured a strong national momentum. Critics have hailed the band as “one of the most exciting names heating up the UK underground” (The Songbird HQ), drawing comparisons to a meeting of The Doors, Led Zeppelin, and Arctic Monkeys. Delivering a „“rollercoaster of tracks that feels strikingly alive““(Good Music Radar), the release has been praised as “loud, and real… a debut that leaves you ready to shout along” (Illustrate Magazine). Proving that “great riffs never go out of fashion” (The Big Takeover), French Dogs provide a “crisp but not clean” collection that “turns poor decisions into pure momentum” (Mystic Sons). They are a band “on fire… giving us the fervour you’d want to hear from a young band with a dream” (Sinusoidal Music). This RSD exclusive is the first-ever physical release for the band and is strictly limited to a small run of 500 units, with each sleeve individually hand-numbered on the back. This EP serves as the definitive preamble to the band’s highly anticipated debut full-length album, scheduled for release.“

Now based in Los Angeles Paul has produced albums for Michael Kiwanuka, Andrew Bird and Teskey Brothers. Pavey Ark also worked with composer and producer Adrian McNally (The Unthanks) who led the live string quartet studio session and co-produced and mixed three songs on the new album.“

releases.title: Live at Oil Can Harry’s

Carefully remastered for pristine sound – this is a limited edition collector’s exclusive. Only available for Record Store Day 2026. „“This Ahmad Jamal record returns for its 50th anniversary. Originally released on the Catalyst label in 1976, ‚Live at Oil Can Harry’s‘ captures the pianist’s August 1975 performance at the legendary Vancouver venue, which was a hub for live music from 1966–77. Ahmad Jamal plays here in quintet format. A masterclass in subtlety, swing, and melodic invention.“

releases.details:
Omnivore Recordings is proud to announce the first-ever vinyl release of Rock And Roll Doctor for Record Store Day. Long out-of-print, this special edition features 15 standout tracks from Jackson Browne, Bonnie Raitt, Randy Newman, JD Souther, Eddie Money, and George’s daughter Inara George in collaboration with Van Dyke Parks. It also includes a previously unissued rendition of George’s signature song “Willin’,” recorded by Willie Nelson and Emmylou Harris featuring Inara George.
 
 This collection is a joyous tribute to one of the 1970s’ most original and influential musical voices. Make your appointment now with the Rock And Roll Doctor!

releases.title: First and Last and Always [RSD 2026 EX]
releases.format: Limited 1 x 140g 12″ Black Ice vinyl album. RSD 2026.
releases.label: Warner Strategic Marketing UK
releases.details: Formed in Leeds in the UK by guitarist Gary Marx and vocalist Andrew Eldritch in 1980, The Sisters Of Mercy released their first full-length album First And Last And Always in March 1985. The culmination of five years of independent releases, whilst building up a large cult following, their debut album reached Number 14 the UK charts, by which time the band also featured Wayne Hussey on guitar and Craig Adams on bass, both of whom would later leave the band to form The Mission. Originally signing to Warner Music in 1984, First And Last And Always was the only album from this highly influential line-up. The album was released in Japan in July 1985, and features different versions of four tracks. Although this unique mix was used for the first CD edition in 1988, this new LP will be the first time that this mix will be available on vinyl outside of Japan. It will also be remastered from a new transfer of the original Japan production master.

releases.title: RONIN: CYBERPUNK 2077 (RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Materia Collective
releases.details: Materia Collective proudly presents Angel Of Man _RONIN: CYBERPUNK 2077, a striking new entry in the world of cinematic game-inspired music. Drawing directly from the cybernetic heart of Cyberpunk 2077, Angel Of Man crafts a bold sonic journey that merges industrial grit, electronic experimentation, and cinematic scope. This Record Store Day exclusive brings fans a 12-track album, including an unreleased, vinyl-only bonus track available nowhere else. From high-octane anthems like Extraction Action and The Heist to reflective soundscapes such as Outsider No More and Rite of Passage, RONIN: CYBERPUNK 2077 embodies the chaos, rebellion, and neon-soaked beauty of Night City. The album is pressed on a Limited-Edition 180g Katana CyberRed 1xLP, featuring a 12” premium vinyl jacket with cyberpunk-inspired original artwork designed exclusively for this release. Each copy is housed in a black poly-lined protective sleeve, making it a collector’s centerpiece for video game music fans, cyberpunk enthusiasts, and vinyl aficionados alike. With its mix of adrenaline-pumping rhythms and haunting electronic atmospheres, this release is both a standalone artistic statement and a love letter to the world of Cyberpunk 2077.

releases.title: Oh! What A Lovely War (+ Six Day War 7″) (Colored RSD Edit.2026)
releases.label: Seelie Court
releases.details: Darkly psychedelic, politically charged, and utterly rare. This one-off psych-rock classic from 1971 still resonates with its anti-war edge. Originally released on the Chess subsidiary Cadet Concept, ‚Oh! What a Lovely War‘ is the sole album by Liverpool’s Colonel Bagshot. The band, initially known as “Colonel Bagshot’s Incredible Bucket Band,” began as a six-piece before condensing into a four-piece, and produced an intense series of 7-inches between 1969 and 1973, earning a devoted cult following. The album’s standout track, “Six Day War,” achieved renewed recognition when DJ Shadow sampled it (renamed “Six Days”) on his 2002 album The Private Press, and later in 2018 by Mahmut Orhan. Seelie Court’s 2026 anniversary reissue comes pressed on psychedelic splatter vinyl with original gtefold sleeve artwork, expanded with additional liner notes and an obi strip. Audio remastered. An additional 7″ single containing two unreleased recordings of “Six Day War” recorded by Brian Farrell (and featuring Ollie Halsall) comes packed inside. An unsophisticated must-have for adventurous psych-rock collectors.

releases.title: There Must Be Another Way – The Singles (Blue RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Jungle Records
releases.details: 24-track singles compilation 2xLP in limited blue vinyl; notes by Colin Jerwood. Sadly, main-man Colin Jerwood died from a heart attack in May 2025, shortly after the release of their first album in 20 years. Conflict are one of the world’s foremost activist anarchist punk band. First heard on their mentors Crass’s label, their ‘to a nation of animal lovers’ EP inspired anti-vivisection, anti-hunt campaigns. Espousing direct action and numerous political causes, on their own Mortarhate label (through Jungle) they dominated the top of the singles and albums indie charts through the eighties. Gigs turned into full-scale riots, with hundreds arrested, leading to national outrage headlines. Police banned them from performing in the UK, so they went underground and abroad. They kept touring; a resurgence of interest in the punk movement reactivated them in the 21st century and they continue to have a dedicated audience.

releases.title: Guillotine Theatre (Red RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Jungle Records
releases.details: „‘Guillotine Theatre’ was the debut album from Cuddly Toys, first released only in Japan in 1979, and then a revamped version in the UK in 1980. Cuddly Toys are the glam-punk band who evolved from the London glam-shock punk band Raped, and often noted for their version of a David Bowie/Marc Bolan unreleased co-write, Madman. Cross-dressing in an era when it was outrageous, their hot-panted Japanese drummer ‘Paddy Phield’ helped them gain fans in his home country. Not on vinyl since the original releases, this double-album version is extended with a whole side of the different Japanese album mixes, two tracks omitted from the UK version, and three 1980 demos from the same line-up. A limited edition in red vinyl, with an obi-strip like the import copies of the Japanese album. An album of Raped recordings was released by US label Puke N Vomit Records in 2024. Singer Sean Purcell died in 1996. A Japanese version of the band, as Cuddly ToyZ led by Paddy, has released an album and regularly gig around Japan.

releases.title: Weapon of Choice (Colored)
releases.label: Cooking Vinyl
releases.details: Available for the first time on vinyl, Weapon of Choice is an earlier take on The Cult’s album Choice of Weapon, produced by Chris Goss, before Bob Rock came on board to help finish the album. Pressed on silver effect vinyl and housed in a mirrorboard sleeve.

releases.title: The Great Western Road Trip: A Live Album (Colored)
releases.label: Cooking Vinyl
releases.details: This blue smoke triple-vinyl-set is housed in a trifold sleeve with poster, each one Individually numbered. Includes 25 career spanning greatest hits and nine tracks from 2025’s Top 3 album The Great Western Road.

releases.title: THE UNDONE IS DONE AGAIN (COLOURED VINYL)
releases.label: FIRE RECORDS
releases.details: This is music that feels both ancient and immediate – haunting, beautiful, and defiantly different on a new EP from Tanya Donelly – co-founder of Belly, Throwing Muses, and The Breeders – and Chris Brokaw, guitarist/singer for the legendary Come and longtime collaborator with Codeine, Thurston Moore, and The Lemonheads. A beautiful reimagining of the centuries-old form of the madrigal for the modern era. Pressed on colour vinyl. 1000 copies worldwide

releases.title: No Country For Old Men
releases.label: ORG MUSIC
releases.details: Recorded especially for Record Store Day 2026, former RSD Ambassador and hip-hop legend Chuck D (Public Enemy) joins forces with The Doors‘ iconic drummer John Densmore for No Country for Old Men, the debut album from their new project doPE. Blending spoken word, rhythm, and raw social commentary, the record bridges generations of rebellion and reflection. The limited-edition vinyl arrives exclusively for Record Store Day 2026, housed in a deluxe gatefold package featuring original illustrations by Chuck D himself. The album includes the RSD Song of the Year „Tick Tick Tick.“

releases.artist: DR. JOHN & THE WDR BIG BAND
releases.title: BIG BAND VOODOO (PURPLE COL. 2LP)
releases.label: ORANGE MUSIC
releases.details: This is the vinyl debut for this Dr. John Album. „Ya know, dis would be dat thing I was always using my head for: a big band thing with my New Orleans riffs.“ Thus spoke Mac Rebennack, a.k.a. Dr. John, while tossing around ideas with his manager Stanley Chaisson ahead of a 1995 Afterglow tour. Not long afterward, he manifested that vision in Cologne, Germany, where he recorded 16 tracks with the horn section of the WDR Big Band. This live set makes a fine addition to every Dr. John fan’s library, and delivers exactly what the good doctor intended to conjure: Big Band Voodoo. Purple col. 2LP, 1000 copies worldwide.

releases.title: SKETCHES FOR MEDICINE SHOW
releases.label: FIRE RECORDS
releases.details: For the most part unreleased rare recordings from The Dream Syndicate’s awesome ‚Medicine Show‘ era, circa 1983-84. Featuring rehearsals and live out-takes, e.g a wayward take on Dylan’s ‚Knocking On Heaven’s Door‘ plus the anti-war opus ‚Morning Dew‘ ft. producer Sandy Pearlman. „Dense with songs of violence, paranoia, lurking evil, and Karl Precoda’s uncanny guitar.“ (Uncut) 1500 copies worldwide

releases.title: EXTRA-CAPSULAR EXTRACTION (COL. LP)
releases.label: FIRE RECORDS
releases.details: Earth, the pioneering project of Dylan Carlson, laid the groundwork for drone metal with their very first release, 1991’s Extra-Capsular Extraction – a three-track EP that features Kurt Cobain on „A Bureaucratic Desire for Revenge, Part 2.“ A cornerstone of heavy minimalism and sludge, pressed on colour vinyl. 1000 copies worldwide

releases.title: DEBRIS (MILKY WHITE VINYL)
releases.label: GLASS MODERN
releases.details: Now on vinyl for the first time, Epic’s 1995 outtakes collection Debris complements his half dozen other albums perfectly, revealing raw assemblages of all those forbidden influences, its intimate and unresolved air creating one of his most compelling releases. 500 copies wordwide

releases.title: EXTENDED PLAY VOLUME I & VOLUME II
releases.label: HISS AND SHAKE
releases.details: Being early on with X-Ray Spex (and later once again), then fronting Essential Logic, Lora Logic has contributed a lot sax to New Wave. Since 2021 she’s back for Essential Logic. This release presents both 2021 comeback EP’s 1 & 2 on Neon ‚Barbie Be Happy‘ Pink vinyl. 500 copies worldwide

releases.title: STUFF
releases.label: GLASS MODERN
releases.details: Simon Fisher Turner has been actor (Schooldays, The Big Sleep), teenage popstar in UK (s/t 1973 album), independent musician (The Gadgets/The The, King Of Luxembourg), solo artist and most of his life soundtrack composer, producer and artist. STUFF is a collection of old and new recordings complied by SFT in New York September 2025.: „There is no conventional instrumentation on this stuff. […] Nothing would have been recorded without the help from film makers Cynthia Beatt, Kamal Aljafari and Derek Jarman.“- SFT 2025. 500 copies worldwide

releases.title: Happy By My Side (7″) (RSD Edit.2026)
releases.label: Seelie Court
releases.details: Indian psych-rock pioneers The Flintstones – Rhett May and Clayton Saunders, who both grew up in Calcutta orphanages – helped ignite India’s underground psych scene. Their rare, earliest single, „Happy By My Side / Be Mine“ (1968), was originally released on EMI India and is now signed to the underground Seelie Court label. This sunny, whimsical, and slightly eccentric 7” will return for Record Store Day 2026 as a facsimile edition, complete with the original psychedelic picture sleeve – the only surviving copy. Super rare and out of print for six decades.

releases.title: Next Thing (10th Anniversary Edition)
releases.label: BAYONET RECORDS
releases.details: Includes 3 demos of previously released tracks, including 2 that will be exclusive to this variant forever.

releases.title: Funkadelic (Picture Disc)
releases.label: ORG MUSIC
releases.details: Originally released in 1970, Funkadelic’s self-titled debut redefined the boundaries of funk, soul, and psychedelic rock. Remastered by Dave Gardner and reissued in August 2025 as part of Org Music’s ongoing Westbound Records series, this landmark album now returns as a limited-edition picture disc, available exclusively for Record Store Day 2026.

releases.title: CONFLUENCE (COLOURED VINYL)
releases.label: FIRE RECORDS
releases.details: First time on vinyl since its original release in 2001. Following Giant Sand’s celebrated ‚Chore Of Enchantment‘, ‚Confluence‘ is a beatnik travelogue traversing moods and mindsets with Howe joined by a host of friends and family along for a trip that mixes spidery piano, an Elvis cover and plenty of dustbowl ambience. Pressed on colour vinyl, 1000 copies worldwide

releases.title: Live in Europe
releases.label: KARMA CHIEF RECORDS
releases.details: In March 2025, after 7 years as a live band, Ghost Funk Orchestra finally made their first overseas voyage to tour Europe and the UK. „Live In Europe“ is a document that showcases the eight-piece touring band at the height of its powers. The track list was constructed from two consecutive sold out shows, the first at Jassmine in Warsaw and the second at Paradiso in Amsterdam. It leans heavily on songs from „An Ode To Escapism“ and „A New Kind Of Love,“ while also including a few songs from „A Trip To The Moon,“ a nod to the early GFO days with the song „Evil Minds,“ and even a few brand new tunes. Both shows were professionally recorded, with Amsterdam’s recording being handled by the Abbey Road Institute. Mastered by Doug Krebs.

releases.title: LIVE AT FIRE 40 (COLOURED VINYL)
releases.label: FIRE RECORDS
releases.details: Exclusive unreleased live recording from Fire Records‘ 40th anniversary extravaganza in London – Giant Syndicate are Giant Sand, Steve Wynn (The Dream Syndicate) plus Kristin Hersh (Throwing Muses). A caustic cacophony, like Neil Young in his Arc Weld period, as Giant Sand are fused with The Dream Syndicate. Home favourites became chemically imbalanced, Iggy’s ‚Lust For Life‘ is revived and Kristin Hersh of Throwing Muses arrives to dismantle Memphis Minnie’s ‚When The Levee Breaks‘. Colouredvinyl, 1000 copies worldwide

releases.title: ETCETERA
releases.label: SUB POP
releases.details: Limited to 100 in Germany for RSD. Curated exclusively for Record Store Day 2026, Sub Pop and The Gits present Etcetera, a thirteen-song collection of unreleased material by Mia Zapata and The Gits. This limited-edition LP features live tour recordings, rare solo performances by Mia Zapata – including covers of Bessie Smith, Iggy & The Stooges, and even James Taylor. Etcetera is the definitive Gits collectors piece hand selected by the band from their personal vault.

releases.title: Serious Dropout
releases.label: Echo Beach
releases.details: From the wicked mixing desk of Greg Dread (Dreadzone & Big Audio Dynamite) plus support by the legendary Don Letts – here’s a special selection presenting the legendary SERIOUS DROPOUT from Frankfurt/M. 12 killer tracks for the first time available on vinyl, a limited edition (paginated and numbered).

releases.title: WE ARE THEY WHO ACHE WITH AMOROUS LOVE (COL. LP)
releases.label: FIRE RECORDS
releases.details: Back on vinyl for the first time in over 25 years. Renowned as one of Kurt Cobain’s favourite albums and not available on vinyl since its original release in 1990. An experimental improv collage of tunes old and new, haphazardly dissected for maximum impact. „One of the longest running art-punk bands in history.“ (The Quietus). Pressed on colour vinyl, 1000 copies worldwide

releases.title: A Tribute to Pharoah Sanders
releases.label: ORG MUSIC
releases.details: Recorded live at the Detroit Institute of Arts on July 20, 2025, A Tribute to Pharoah Sanders captures Detroit reed master Wendell Harrison and his ensemble TRIBE in a transcendent performance honoring Harrison’s longtime friend and fellow jazz icon. The concert_part of Detroit’s Concert of Colors festival and later broadcast on PBS_finds Harrison channeling Sanders‘ spirit through deep tenor cries, hypnotic grooves, and Afro-spiritual improvisation. Joined by an exceptional group of musicians including Sky Covington, Pamela Wise, Michael Abbo, Sam Melkonian, Kevin Dalton Jones, Allen Denard, Edward Gooche, Stephen Grady, Roberto Warren, and special guests, Harrison leads an inspired exploration of sound and soul. This limited LP will be released on vinyl exclusively for Record Store Day 2026.

releases.title: Tina Harvey (RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Trading Places
releases.details: Single LP with original cover and new labels. First European redition ever since the album’s publication in 1973.

releases.artist: HELIOCENTRICS, THE/ALLEN, MARSHALL /SCOTT, KNOEL FT. BILAL
releases.title: Nuclear War (Colored)
releases.label: Strut Records
releases.details: Unreleased 2015 studio session featuring The Heliocentrics, Sun Ra Arkestra members Marshall Allen & Knoel Scott, and vocalist Bilal. Pressed on limited-edition „hazardous“ orange/yellow vinyl. 4-track EP including new versions of „Angels And Demons At Play“, „Where Pathways Meet“, „Astro Black“ (with Bilal), and a cavernous rework of „Nuclear War.“

releases.title: The Voice In Sound
releases.label: Echo Beach
releases.details: Ltd 180g Black Vinyl LP (includes CD with bonus tracks). 10 killer tracks for the first time available on vinyl, processed and edited for longplay album release. Side A represents the more traditional Jamaican vibes of Reggae and Dub, Side B the more atmospheric and electronic Dub side.

releases.title: My Old Man (RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Puddlebrook Records
releases.details: Privately issued in the UK in 1976 and recorded in a single twelve-hour session at Spaceward Studios, Bob Hughes’ ‘My Old Man’ is one of the lost treasures of British folk’s DIY underground. Marking its 50th anniversary in 2026, the album captures this poet, singer-songwriter, and behavioural scholar at his creative peak – delivering intimate, melancholic folk and folk-rock songs that tackle social conflict, historical memory, and deeply personal narratives. A defining UK private-press rarity and among the rarest and most valuable folk records of its era (less than 100 original copies in existence). This reissue has been sought after for decades by underground private-press collectors. Official one-time reissue copies available for RSD 26.

releases.title: White Gloves ii / M. Blanc
releases.label: DEAD OCEANS
releases.details: On Nov. 6th, 2025 Khruangbin released The Universe Smiles Upon You ii, the reimagined version of their debut album The Universe Smiles Upon You, on its 10-year anniversary. The new album features a new sequencing with every song re-recorded, all with various degrees of subtlety and musical reinterpretation. The original album had a secret bonus track that was featured on a JCD, and they’re replicating this approach by holding „M. Blanc“ (entitled „Mr. White“ on the original album) as the bonus track specifically for the JCD and RSD exclusive products.

releases.title: Manoeuvres (RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Trading Places
releases.details: Single LP with original cover and new labels. First European redition since 1983.

releases.title: Bubblegum (White Vinyl RSD Edition)
releases.label: Beggars Banquet
releases.details: Diese streng limitierte Veröffentlichung von Mark Lanegans Album Bubblegum markiert das erste Mal, dass seine ursprüngliche Vision für die Platte präsentiert wird. Während der Aufnahmesessions nahmen Mark und seine hochkarätige Riege an Mitwirkenden (PJ Harvey, Joshua Homme, Greg Dulli, Duff McKagan u. a.) genügend Material für zwei Alben auf, doch die Pläne änderten sich und die endgültige Titelliste des Albums fiel deutlich anders aus. Diese Edition zeigt nun Mark Lanegans ursprüngliches Konzept für das Album. Auf weißem Vinyl gepresst, wurde dieses 2×LP-Set von Geoff Pesche in den Abbey Road Studios hervorragend gemastert. Die Erlöse aus dem Verkauf werden an die neu gegründete Mark Lanegan Foundation gespendet.

releases.title: Animal Pleasure + Tall in the Saddle & more (Red RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Jungle Records
releases.details: The original 1982 album plus the 1984 mini-LP and three previously unreleased tracks. The first time on vinyl since the 80’s, in a limited-edition, red vinyl double-LP. Notes by London Cowboys’ Steve Dior and Barry Jones. From the embryonic London punk scene, they were so embedded they’ve played alongside both four of the Sex Pistols and four of the New York Dolls! Guitarist Barry Jones was a co-promoter at the famous Roxy Club (and later at Max’s KC); Steve Dior was a young punk scenester. First, The Idols formed in New York in 1978 with Steve Dior, Barry Jones and Jerry Nolan after he quit the Heartbreakers, releasing a single on US label Ork Records. The Idols (with Arthur Kane) then became Sid Vicious’s band for his final Max’s Kansas City shows. Jerry had UK work permit issues, so The Idols became the London Cowboys, who attracted more names from the punk scene; including Glen Matlock, Tony James and Terry Chimes. Gigging around the UK and Europe they signed with the French Underdog label in 1982, issuing Animal Pleasure in ’82 and Tall in the Saddle in ’84. Subsequently Barry joined Johnny Thunders band alongside Glen Matlock & Jerry Nolan (& Arthur Kane in the USA). Steve Dior formed Filthy Lucre with Phil Lewis. In 2025, Dior & Jones announced that a new London Cowboys album was being recorded in London.

releases.title: Songs Of Protest And Anti Protest (Colored)
releases.label: Poppydisc
releases.details: Chris Lucey’s legendary 1960s psych-folk album, long considered one of the most mysterious and collectible West Coast records, blends raw folk-rock energy with surreal, LSD-fueled creativity. This very limited Record Store Day 2026 edition comes on purple vinyl with an exclusive hype sticker, making it an essential piece for psych collectors and vinyl enthusiasts.

releases.title: Natural History (Purple RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Jungle Records
releases.details: The original 1984 album, reissued for the first time since the 1980’s. A limited edition in purple vinyl, and with a ‚US Zillion $ Bill‘ 24-inch x 12-inch insert with lyrics on the rear – as came with limited quantities of the original pressing. Features Snake Dance, Religious As Hell, Crow Baby and two tracks they chose from John Peel Sessions. Since the band reformed they have toured the UK, Europe and USA extensively, and more dates are scheduled for 2026. A new album ‚Crocodile Promises‘ was released by Metropolis Records in 2024, and more recordings are under way.

releases.title: DEVIL ON THE WIND (COL. VINYL)
releases.label: VINYL STAR
releases.details: First time on vinyl, remastered for vinyl. The Men They Couldn’t Hang release their classic album ‚Devil On The Wind‘ as LP. Recorded in 2009 with legendary British producer Pat Collier. ‚Devil on the Wind‘ combines the band’s famed live ferocity and undiminished lyricism to create an essential rock folk hybrid very much relevant in these volatile modern times. This essential release highlights the heart and soul of The Men They Couldn’t Hang – as someone once said, The Clash jamming with The Byrds! 1000 coloured vinyl copies worldwide

appleMusic.artistName: Anne-Sophie Mutter, Recording Arts Orchestra of Los Angeles & John Williams

releases.title: Complete Recordings (RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Trading Places
releases.details: Double LP with new cover and labels. First ever edition of the group’s masterpieces.

releases.title: INSTINCT (COLOURED VINYL)
releases.label: FIRE RECORDS
releases.details: Back on vinyl after 3 decades, Instinct is The Moles‘ cult masterpiece from 1994, with new liner notes by main man Richard Davies. A courageous baroque pop gem filled with yearning and coming-of-age psychedelic folk angst. This album is dazzling baroque and unique psych pop. Pressed on colour vinyl with faithfully restored artwork. 1000 copies worldwide

releases.artist: MY LIFE WITH THE THRILL KILL KULT
releases.title: Sinister Whispers: The Wax Trax! Years Remixed (Colored RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Wax Trax! Records
releases.details: It’s time to bust out that leather thong, and strap-on those combat boots – My Life With The Thrill Kill Kult remixxxes their Wax Trax! Klassiks for a limited 2LP vinyl release. Originally released in 2010 on CD only, these special remixes and alternative versions by Groovie Mann & Buzz McCoy have been physically out print for over a decade, and will be the first time available in vinyl. Slither onto the dance floor with these incredible remixed versions of “Daisy Chain 4 Satan”, “Cooler Than Jesus”, “Do You Fear For Your Child”, and more! For a special treat this limited release will have an exclusive GLOW IN THE DARK cover and special color variant…THIS EDITION AVAILABLE FOR RSD 2026 ONLY!

releases.title: Bicycles & Tricycles (Clear Vinyl)
releases.label: Cooking Vinyl
releases.details: The Orb’s 2004 album as a Special ltd edition pressed on clear double vinyl, housed in a widespine, spot glossed sleeve with printed inners. Includes an extra track ‘Now Here’ originally only available on the Japanese release of the album.

releases.title: Perfect Sound Forever EP (White Vinyl RSD Edition)
releases.label: Matador
releases.details: Die erste Wiederveröffentlichung überhaupt der 1991 erschienenen Kult-EP Perfect Sound Forever von Pavement erscheint zum Record Store Day 2026 auf weißem 10″-Vinyl. Mit sieben essenziellen frühen Tracks aus der Feder von Stockton, Kaliforniens Finest – darunter „Heckler Spray“ und „Debris Slide“, Songs, die die Band auch 35 Jahre nach ihrer ursprünglichen Veröffentlichung noch live spielt.

releases.title: TOM RAPP: THE MAN WHO FELL TO EARTH
releases.label: EARTH RECORDINGS
releases.details: A mesmerising, super rare ten-track collection of songs from Pearls‘ mainstay Tom Rapp; a stripped-down study of love, hate and the state of the world, recorded over 50 years ago and still as poignant and incisive today. Featuring music never released or set to vinyl from Rapp’s private collection, created with the blessing of Tom’s family. 1000 copies worldwide

releases.title: FOUND DOGS
releases.label: OH BOY RECORDS
releases.details: To celebrate the 30th anniversary of Lost Dogs & Mixed Blessings, Found Dogs uncovers rare recordings from the original sessions. The record includes alternate takes, acoustic versions, and four never-before-heard tracks all newly mastered for vinyl that offer a deeper look into John Prine’s creative process. Featuring gems like „Hey Ah Nothin‘,“ „World Without Love,“ and „Dogs in Burlington,“ the collection captures Prine’s humor, heart, and storytelling. This foil-numbered LP is exclusive to Record Store Day, giving fans the first chance to experience these long-lost moments before any digital or D2C release.

releases.title: THE RACE FOR SPACE/REMIXES (PALE GREEN VINYL)
releases.label: TEST CARD RECORDINGS
releases.details: Special vinyl repress of the long sold out remix LP from 2016. 8 tracks that tell the story of the USA and USSR’s battle for supremacy in space, this time remixed by and through the lens of PSB’s talented musical contemporaries. . The original Race For Space reached #11 in the UK album charts in its first week, selling over 100k records worldwide since its release, recently achieving Gold status in the UK. „This is the pinnacle of what PSB are trying to achieve, by breathing new life into dusty old relics, and it makes for truly magical, exhilarating listening“ (The 405). 1000 copies worldwide on Pale Green vinyl

releases.title: I Did Not Mean To Turn You On (Dub You On) – Colored
releases.label: Echo Beach
releases.details: Ltd 7“, Colored Vinyl (paginated and numbered). “RE-201” is a new project from Echo Beach’s closest circle of producers, a tribute to the legendary Roland Space Echo. Featuring Peter Heppner & Mika Bajinsky.

releases.title: MindsEye
releases.label: Erased Tapes
releases.details:
Rival Consoles, UK producer Ryan Lee West, shares his original score for MindsEye, the highly anticipated narrative-driven game from Build A Rocket Boy, the studio led by visionary game director Leslie Benzies. The industrial techno score doesn’t just accompany the game, it’s embedded in the code of the world they have created together. The full score sees its debut on vinyl for the first time as a limited-edition Record Store Day 2026 release.
 Set in Redrock, a sprawling desert metropolis ruled by surveillance and automation, MindsEye follows Jacob Diaz, an ex-soldier haunted by fractured memories. As his personal mission escalates, he’s forced to navigate a world shaped by rogue AI, militarized tech, and a fragile grip on control, all while confronting the truth about his past.
 „In MindsEye, sound is a critical storytelling layer, from ambient detail to emotional drive, every element is designed to shape how players feel inside the world,“ said Craig Conner, audio director at Build A Rocket Boy. „Rival Consoles‘ tracks brought something truly special to that vision. Ryan’s music adds a distinct emotional charge and texture that elevates key moments. It doesn’t just accompany the game, it sharpens its edge, deepens its atmosphere, and perfectly complements the world we’ve built.“
 The score was produced over the span of three years in his London studio, and contains some of West’s most ambitious and heaviest compositions to date. To coincide with today’s release of the game, the 10-track score is now available to stream in its entirety.
 MindsEye follows West’s previous scoring work, including bespoke music for 2019’s Black Mirror episode Striking Vipers, featuring ‚I Love This, I Love You‘, 2022’s Netflix feature doc El Caso Figo about the legendary football player Luís Figo, and Alexander Whitley’s contemporary dance production Overflow, which was released as a studio album with the same name in 2021. The most recent Rival Consoles album, Landscape from Memory, was released in July 2025 to critical and fan
 acclaim. A world tour continues into mid-2026.

releases.title: THE FIRST BLOOD MYSTERY (25TH ANNIVERSARY DELUXE ED.)
releases.label: DO YOURSELF IN
releases.details: Double silver vinyl reissue! British singer-songwriter Carina Round (alsino Puscifer) marks the 25th Anniversary of her critically acclaimed debut ‚The First Blood Mystery‘ with this limited edition vinyl pressing of the original album and bonus record containing rare and previously unreleased vinyl content and expanded artwork. Alternative/Rock, 500 copies ww.

releases.title: Compendium
releases.label: Trading Places
releases.details: Single LP with new cover and labels. First ever compendium of the group’s rare recordings.

releases.title: UNTITLED (ALBINI ROUGH MIXES)
releases.label: TOUCH & GO
releases.details: Despite Steve Albini relentlessly advocating for Touch and Go Records to release Tweez in 1989, we declined. A few weeks later, Steve invited Slint to an impromptu recording session to make use of some studio time booked by another band who did not show up. At the end of the session, Steve did a quick mix for the band to take home. The next day, Steve dropped off a tape of those mixes to me at the Touch and Go office. These new Slint recordings blew my mind and I could not stop listening to them. Shortly thereafter, we agreed to release Slint’s next album on Touch and Go – the soon to be recorded Spiderland. – Corey Rusk, Touch and Go Records

releases.title: Power Pop (1977-81) – Colored
releases.label: Soul Jazz Records
releases.details: Brings together a wealth of punk/power pop/new wave tunes from American bands that were all originally released in the USA on small and independent labels in the late-70s/early-80s. one-off pressing on heavyweight single red transparent vinyl.

releases.title: Studio One Sound (Colored)
releases.label: Soul Jazz Records
releases.details: First ever colour vinyl edition of this classic album. Fully remastered. Exclusive one-off pressing on heavyweight double transparent green vinyl.

releases.title: Swamp Dogg Gets His Pool Painted
releases.label: JOYFUL NOISE
releases.details: Official, first-time release of soundtrack for film Swamp Dogg Gets His Pool Painted.

releases.title: Words of Wisdom and Hope (LP + 7″)
releases.label: MERGE
releases.details: Long OOP collab album from two indie rock institutions.

releases.title: EDITIONS II: SPACE FEST
releases.label: GLASS MODERN
releases.details: Recorded live at Spacefest! Gdañsk, Poland, December 4, 2015. Sonically huge sprawling shamanistic improvised atmospheric live album from the masters of mesmerising drone, stratospheric feedback and deep spacedriven noisefucks. Totally unique, as always. Including rendition of „The Perfect Needle“. Never previously released on vinyl, 500 copies worldwide.

releases.title: Acoustic (Clear Vinyl)
releases.label: Cooking Vinyl
releases.details: Tanita Tikaram’s Acoustic Album makes its long-awaited debut on vinyl for Record Store Day 2026. Available on Crystal Clear LP, this intimate collection strips her songs back to their emotional core, highlighting Tikaram’s unmistakable voice and timeless songwriting. Featuring her signature track, “Twist in My Sobriety”.

releases.title: (RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Blissful Serenity Industries, LLC
releases.details: The Night in Question: French Exit Outtakes. A collection of unfinished songs considered and abandoned during the legendary “French Exit” sessions. Lightly mastered but mostly presented to you here in their unfinished „demo-esque“ state.

releases.title: Westbound Sound: Westbound Records Curated by RSD Vol.3
releases.label: ORG MUSIC
releases.details: This limited edition LP was curated from the legendary Westbound Records catalog by participating Record Store Day stores, marking the third installment in the ongoing Westbound Records Curated by Record Store Day series. Volume 3 features standout tracks originally issued as 45rpm singles, handpicked by the dedicated record store community that keeps this music alive.

releases.title: Video Game LoFi: Pokémon Lullabies (Deluxe RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Curaga Records
releases.details: Curaga Records is thrilled to present a special Record Store Day release celebrating the 30th anniversary of Pokémon in 2026. Video Game LoFi: Pokémon Lullabies – Deluxe Edition brings together two respected labels—Curaga Records and Chill Ghost—to produce a carefully curated collection of lo-fi and sleep-inspired Pokémon remixes. This 1xLP vinyl features 12-15 standout tracks selected from a larger 50-track digital album, representing the most enchanting and relaxing reinterpretations of music across the Pokémon franchise. With lush textures, warm tape-saturated drums, gentle jazzy undertones, and ethereal chillhop arrangements, this album transforms iconic Pokémon melodies into serene lo-fi experiences perfect for relaxation, study, or simply revisiting beloved childhood memories. Artists from both Curaga Records and Chill Ghost bring their signature production styles to the project, combining deep respect for the original compositions with innovative lo-fi interpretations. The album is packaged in a poly-lined protective sleeve with custom cover art designed specifically for this release by ArtbyGalen and Save Point, finished in a smooth matte for collectors and fans alike. This Record Store Day exclusive vinyl is a must-have for Pokémon enthusiasts, lo-fi collectors, and video game music fans, offering a tangible keepsake from one of the biggest cultural anniversaries of the decade.

releases.title: UNDERTALE (10-Year Anniversary Remixes) ( Purple RSD Edit. 2026)
releases.label: Monstercat, Firaga Records
releases.details: To celebrate a decade of Undertale, Firaga Records and global EDM powerhouse Monstercat are thrilled to unveil a special Record Store Day variant of UNDERTALE (10-Year Anniversary Remixes). This exclusive 1xLP vinyl features an all-star lineup of Monstercat legends, including ØneHeart, Pegboard Nerds, Haywyre, Tokyo Machine, No Mana, alongside Firaga favorites such as VGR, Roborob, RoBKTA, Vector U, and PrototypeRaptor. Featuring 10 electrifying remixes of iconic tracks from the game, this release fuses deep respect for Toby Fox’s original compositions with bold, dancefloor-ready energy. The result? A once-in-a-generation VGM remix album that reimagines Undertale through the lens of cutting-edge electronic sound. Pressed on an eye-catching purple vinyl variant and packaged in an exclusive Record Store Day design, this edition is crafted to impress collectors and appeal to longtime fans alike. More than a tribute, it’s a celebration of one of the most influential indie games ever made—and a keepsake worthy of its legacy.

releases.title: INTIAANI KESA

A suitably eerie and ethereal collection of ambient pieces with a nod to the Cocteau’s Liz Fraser, Tangerine Dream and Ennio Morricone. Reissued for the first time in 15 years, with brand new revitalised artwork. 1000 copies worldwide

releases.title: The Complete Peel Sessions (Crystal Clear RSD Edition)
releases.label: 4AD
releases.details: Die deutschen Punk-Pioniere Xmal Deutschland – Anfang der Achtziger bei britischen Publikum hochverehrt für ihre düstere, hypnotische und zugleich tanzbare Darkwave-Ästhetik, meist auf Deutsch gesungen – traten zwischen 1982 und 1985 insgesamt viermal live in der BBC-Radio-1-Sendung des legendären DJs John Peel auf. Aus dem Hamburger Art-Punk-Underground hervorgegangen und häufig der Szene der Neuen Deutschen Welle zugeordnet, fand die Band schnell eine treue Fangemeinde in Großbritannien, nachdem sie bei 4AD unterschrieben hatte und ausgiebig mit Labelkollegen wie Cocteau Twins, Clan of Xymox und Dead Can Dance tourte. Nun werden erstmals sämtliche Peel-Sessions-Aufnahmen der Band an einem Ort versammelt – exklusiv zum Record Store Day als 2×LP-Set auf silbernem Vinyl erhältlich. Die 16 Songs umfassende Anthologie, 2026 in den Abbey Road Studios neu remastert, enthält Fan-Favoriten wie „Incubus Succubus“, „Mondlicht“, „Geheimnis“ und „Qual“. Die Veröffentlichung präsentiert neues Artwork von Timothy O’Donnell sowie Bandfotografien von Jörg Bohm.

releases.title: We Are Not Live
releases.label: Charly
releases.details: 2026 Record Store Day Reprise of the 1968 album ‚LIVE‘ by the 13th Floor Elevators. Panned at the time for being billed as „live“ when in fact it was a compilation of previosuly recorded studio masters, outtakes and alternate mixes. The „very loud“ crowd noise was overdubbed and was actually taken from a boxing match and wholly inappropriate for the purpose. Now, almost 60 years on, the album masters are available, in their original sequence, without the crowd noise, to be enjoyed in their full psychedelic splendor.

releases.details: 1983 – No Parole from Rock ’n‘ Roll is the 1st studio album by heavy metal band Alcatrazz, led by veteran singer Graham Bonnet & guitar Aficionado Yngwie Malmsteen. It spent 7 weeks on the Billboard 200 albums chart. The album precipitated guitarist Yngwie Malmsteen’s solo career, and is most famous for the single „Island in the Sun“. This is a special deluxe 2 LP set – 1 LP wil be the original release & 2nd LP will be an instrumental version of the original release.

releases.title: The Seduction of Claude Debussy
releases.label: Demon
releases.details:
*** Never before released on Vinyl! Limited Translucent Blue Double-Vinyl! ***
 
 Finally!, the fifth and final studio album by The Art of Noise and their only studio album never before released on vinyl, sees that fact corrected with an exclusive pressing for Record Store Day 2026 on Translucent Blue 2LP. The album line-up consisted of Trevor Horn, Anne Dudley, Paul Morley and Lol Creme, along with other appearances from John Hurt, soprano Sally Bradshaw, Rakim, and Donna Lewis.
 
 The Seduction of Claude Debussy is the fifth and final studio album by The Art of Noise, released in 1999 and saw the realisation of a long time recurring idea of Trevor Horns’ (as borrowed by the Pet Shop Boys lyric in ‘Left To My Own Devices’) with the blending of music of French impressionist composer Claude Debussy with drum and bass, opera, hip hop, jazz, and narration, to create a concept album described as „the soundtrack to a film that wasn’t made about the life of Claude Debussy.“
 
 The album is newly mastered by Phil Kinrade at Air Studios using the original production master and includes the Rakim featuring single ‘Metaforce’ and in addition this Exclusive Double Vinyl LP features four era specific bonus tracks.
 
 The bonus tracks originally to be released in July 1998 as a 12“ single to promote the album, were previously only released on the Digital EP ‘Born Again!’ and have never been released on a physical format before now.

releases.title: At George Jazzcafe , Arnhem, 1983, The Netherlands
releases.label: MOV
releases.details:
180 gram audiophile vinyl
 Gatefold sleeve
 Live recorded at George Jazzcafé, Arnhem, the Netherlands and New Morning, Paris, France
 Four intimate performances featuring „Walkin“, „Solar“ Star Eyes“ and „September Song“
 Includes liner notes by Wim and Ria Wigt, the 1983 Dutch newspaper Gelderlander review and an excerpt from the George Jazzcafé: An Arnhem Legend 1974-1996 book
 Limited edition of 1000 individually numbered copies on blue coloured vinyl
 Available on vinyl for the first time
 
 Chet Baker At George Jazzcafé was recorded live in 1983 at George Jazzcafé in Arnhem, the Netherlands and at New Morning, Paris France.
 Dutch Jazz pioneers Wim and Ria Wigt had the privilege of supporting Chet’s lifestyle by offering him a steady series of concerts that suited his way of living and traveling. The line-up often changed, depending on the tour. These four live recordings were made during a memorable run with two outstanding musicians from Copenhagen: veteran pianist Duke Jordan and bassist Jesper Lundgaard. The album offers a first selection from the tapes of a tour which took place at George Jazzcafé in Arnhem and New Morning in Paris. Chet Baker performs “Walkin’”, “Solar” (written by Miles Davis) and “Star Eyes” all three recorded at George Jazzcafé as well as “September Song“ recorded at New Morning. 
 All tracks are available on vinyl for the first time. The gatefold sleeve includes liner-notes by Wim and Ria Wigt, an original review published in the Dutch newspaper De Gelderlander in 1983 and an excerpt from the book George Jazzcafé: An Arnhem Legend 1974-1996 released in 2024.
 Chet Baker At George Jazzcafé is available as a limited edition of 1000 individually numbered copies on blue coloured vinyl.

releases.title: Rebirth
releases.label: Culture Factory
releases.details: 1970 – Rebirth is the 2nd (and most successful) of the 3 studio albums from British progressive rock band Blonde on Blonde. It is noted for its more coherent and ambitious sound compared to their debut, Contrasts, featuring a mix of melodic progressive rock, heavy tracks with a new vocalist, Dave Thomas, providing a tougher rock edge. Key tracks include the epic „Colour Questions“ and the Moody Blues-esque „Castles In The Sky“. Blonde on Blonde epitomizes the vibrant spirit of the 1960s British rock scene, characterized by boundless creativity, sonic experimentation, and an unwavering commitment to artistic exploration.

releases.title: Up Here
releases.label: Demon
releases.details:
*** RSD Exclusive Version of New Album! Limited Zoetrope Picture Disc! ***
 Joff Bush and the Bluey Music team proudly present the brand-new Bluey album – ‘Up Here’ – The Orchestral album. Featuring 17 brand-new recordings including ‘Sleepytime’, ‘Flat Pack’, ‘Seesaw’, and the new ‘Bluey Theme Tune (Orchestral Version)’- presented with exclusive zoetrope artwork, this is a must have for fans of Bluey. 
 “This was our most ambitious album to date – so we wanted something extra special – something we’ve wanted to make for a long time. Orchestral music can be so emotionally powerful and to be introducing kids and families to this music is an opportunity I treasure. Hearing the music from episodes like ‘Sleepytime’ and ‘The Sign’ in all its orchestral splendour meant tissues needed to be on hand throughout the mixing process.”
 “Fittingly, the theme of this album is ‘growing up’. Much of this music, like the episodes they derive from, explore what it means when kids start to discover their independence and venture out on their own. Whether that’s learning to sleep in their own bed or taking a spaceship to Mars. I hope you enjoy ‘Up Here’, as the opportunity I had to make this album is thanks to YOU! Your wonderful support of the music in Bluey has allowed us to take it to new heights.”
