releases.title: All In The Mind (The Expanded Edition)
releases.label: MOV
releases.details:
180 gram audiophile vinyl
 Produced by Dj Kenny „Dope“ Gonzalez
 Expanded Edition
 Featuring the worldwide hit „The Bomb! (These Sounds Fall Into My Mind)“ reaching #5 in The UK, and named one of the best dance songs of all time
 Includes the follow-up single „Got Myself Together“ and 3 exclusive bonus tracks
 Album artwork replicates the iconic graffiti cover
 Includes an insert with credits
 Available as limited edition of 2000 individually numbered copies on translucent green vinyl
 
 The Bucketheads All In The Mind album was the solo project by American DJ and producer Kenny “Dope” Gonzalez, who is one half of the legendary house music duo Masters At Work team alongside Little “Louie” Vega.
 The single “The Bomb! (These Sounds Fall Into My Mind)” was released in February 1995 and became a hit in the United Kingdom, reaching number five on the UK Singles Chart. It also reached number one on the US Billboard Dance Club Play, and became a global dancefloor anthem.
 Sampling Chicago’s “Street Player” and featuring the voice of Reverend C.L. Franklin, a lyric taken from “The Preacher Man” by Green Velvet, “The Bomb!” was ranked by Rolling Stone, Billboard and several music magazines as one of the best dance songs of all time.
 The All In The Mind album was released in 1995, and includes alongside “The Bomb”, the follow-up single “Got Myself Together,” “Time And Space (Remix)” which samples “Starchild” by Level 42, “You’re A Runaway,” sampling Linda Clifford’s classic disco song “Runaway Love”, and more tracks.
 This expanded 2LP edition also features three bonus tracks, the Massive Drum Radio Edit of “The Bomb!”, previously Japan only “Got Myself Together (Hustlers Convention Remix)”, and “Whew” (Johnick Edit). The album artwork replicates the iconic graffiti cover, includes an insert with credits, and is available as limited edition of 2000 individually numbered copies on translucent green coloured vinyl.

releases.title: It Is So Easy
releases.label: Culture Factory
releases.details: Buddy Holly remains one of the true architects of early rock & roll, blending irresistible melodies, innovative songwriting, and a sound that continues to influence generations. It Is So Easy brings together his most iconic recordings, including “That’ll Be the Day,” “Peggy Sue,” “Everyday,” “Rave On,” “True Love Ways,” and “Not Fade Away.” Fully remastered to highlight the clarity and brilliance of Holly’s original performances, this compilation celebrates the timeless spirit of a genuine pioneer.

releases.title: 2 Meter Sessions
releases.label: Charly
releases.details:
Never-Before-Released Recordings – Amsterdam 1997 & 2000
 
 For the first time ever on vinyl, The Jayhawks present 2 METER SESSIONS – an exclusive Record Store Day 2026 release featuring two Amsterdam sessions from 1997 and 2000.
 
 Side A revisits the Sound of Lies era with “Trouble,” “Sound of Lies,” and “Big Star” in alternate acoustic versions, plus “Sister Cry,” extended from the 1992 Hollywood Town Hall era with loose, expressive instrumental interplay.
 
 Side B highlights the Smile era with “Somewhere in Ohio,” “Mr. Wilson,” “I’m Gonna Make You Love Me,” “What Led Me to This Town,” and “Smile.” These performances hum with warmth and space, capturing a band reconnecting with the heart of their songs.
 
 Each copy includes signed postcards featuring a black-and-white session still and a personal note from the band members, plus access to an archival video interview with Gary Louris and Marc Perlman.
 
 “If someone really gets our music, they feel it – it goes beyond the surface.” – The Jayhawks

releases.title: Caminho De Esperança Coladance 80
releases.label: Charly
releases.details:
The Cape Verdean masterpiece returns – remastered, restored, and ready to set dancefloors alight once again.
 
 This Record Store Day, vinyl lovers and world music fans can finally get their hands on Caminho De Esperança Coladance 80 by Cabo Verde Show. First released in 1980 and long out of print, original copies have become collector’s treasures, fetching hundreds of dollars. Now reissued on vinyl for the first time ever, this radiant fusion of Latin and African rhythms explodes onto limited-edition “Sunset” Crystal Clear Amber vinyl, newly remastered to sound better than ever.
 
 Formed in Paris in the late 1970s, Cabo Verde Show blended traditional Cape Verdean roots with global dancefloor energy. On Caminho De Esperança, the band reached their creative peak, delivering timeless tracks like “Coladance 80,” “Nova Coladeira,” and “Terra Longe” – each glowing with life, love, and exile’s bittersweet beauty.
 
 A hidden gem reborn, Caminho De Esperança remains one of the most exhilarating Latin-African dance albums of its era – a timeless celebration of rhythm, hope, and Cape Verdean soul.

releases.title: Right Now…And Then
releases.label: Strata-East Records
releases.details:
The debut album from trumpeter and Strata-East co-founder Charles Tolliver. This edition offers a limited edition collectable Strata-East stickers available exclusively for Record Store Day 2026. In his debut release, Charles assembles a who’s who of jazz royalty – Gary Bartz, Herbie Hancock, Ron Carter and Joe Chambers – backing the 26-year-old composer, showcasing his unmatched creativity and control of his instrument. Remixed by Charles to enhance the original intent of the recording, this edition features audio cut directly from the original analog tapes, mastered by Kevin Gray and pressed on 180-gram vinyl at RTI, housed in a deluxe tip-on jacket package with never-before-seen photos and newly commissioned liner notes.
 
 This is a 2026 Record Store Day Release.

releases.title: Blue Lake
releases.label: Charly
releases.details:
DON CHERRY – Blue Lake (Deluxe 2LP Edition)
 
 The spirit of Don Cherry soars again. For Record Store Day 2026, Charly Records and BYG Records present the first-ever official reissue of Blue Lake, Cherry’s transcendent live set originally released in 1974 only in Japan and long out of print. Fully restored and remastered from the original master tapes, this deluxe 2LP gatefold edition brings back to life one of the rarest treasures in the avant-jazz canon – a record that has fetched hundreds of dollars on the collector market for decades.
 
 Following the success of last year’s Record Store Day release of Orient – which captured music from the same 1971 concert – this long-awaited companion volume completes the picture of Cherry’s pan-global vision: a sound that dissolves borders and dances between jazz, folk, and world ritual.
 
 Recorded live in Paris on April 22, 1971, the performance captures Cherry at his creative zenith, alongside South African bassist Johnny Dyani and Turkish percussionist Okay Temiz. The trio moves like a living organism – fluid, spontaneous, and deeply spiritual. The opening piece, Blue Lake, finds Cherry on flute, channeling Native American inflections that blend seamlessly with Far-Eastern tonalities. The following two extended compositions – each stretching past the twenty-five-minute mark – are sprawling journeys of rhythm and resonance, rich with cross-cultural dialogue and ecstatic improvisation.
 
 This deluxe reissue comes housed in a beautiful gatefold sleeve and features new, in-depth liner notes by acclaimed jazz writer Kevin Le Gendre, offering fresh insight into Cherry’s universal musical philosophy.
 
 A lost masterpiece, reborn for Record Store Day 2026
 Don Cherry’s Blue Lake: the sound of freedom without frontiers.

releases.title: Deception
releases.label: Chrysalis Records
releases.details: THE COLOURFIELD were formed during the Summer of 1983 by former Specials and Fun Boy Three vocalist, Terry Hall along with ex- Swinging Cats organist Toby Lyons, and bassist Karl Shale. Following on from last years RSD vinyl reissue of their debut album, ‚Virgins & Philistines‘, we follow it with their second album exclusive for Record Store Day 2026 ‚Deception‘, featuring the tracks ‚Heart of America‘ and ‚Miss Texas 1967‘, along with two singles, Running Away (Sly Stone) and ‚She‘ (The Monkees). As a bonus and exclusive to this release are the Studios Davout sessions, which feature the first version of the album recorded at the famous Paris studio, before the band decamped to New York to re-record the album. Taken from the recently released 96 track Box Set, Sound of The Colourfield, which features the complete recordings of the bands short lived career. The format is 2LP Clear Vinyl, housed in a wide spine sleeve, printed inners and OBI.

releases.title: From Form To Spirit
releases.label: Culture Factory
releases.details:
John Coltrane – From Form to Spirit needs no persuasion: this Gold triple vinyl speaks entirely for itself.
 From the early fire of “Trane’s Blues” and “Straight Street” to the revelations of “Blue Train” and “Moment’s Notice,” and the ascensions of “Giant Steps,” “Naima,” or “My Favorite Things,” each side traces the evolution of a musician moving from form… to spirit.
 Wrapped in an elegant metallic Gold Pantone trifold, the edition includes an exclusive text, integrated photos, and precise details for every session.
 For the centennial Coltrane would have celebrated in 2026, this piece isn’t a tribute.
 It’s an inevitability.

releases.title: Shy Girl Dub
releases.label: Mr Bongo Records
releases.details:
Following the release of Hollie Cook’s fifth studio album, Shy Girl, and her return to Mr Bongo 15 years after her debut, the album’s producer Ben McKone reconstructs the recordings into a newly cut dubwise release. Made for Record Store Day 2026, Ben strips back the productions in vintage dub reggae style. Crafted on an analogue mixing desk, he weaves in delays, echoes, and reverb to push Hollie’s trademark sound into a hypnotising, rhythm and bass-heavy, electronic realm.
 
 
 
 Rich in the tradition of reggae albums from the late ‘60s onwards, Hollie wanted to reimagine Shy Girl through a dub-focused lens. Evidently, only one person seemed the perfect fit to do so: Ben McKone of the General Roots, who was the producer of Shy Girl and featured heavily across the album as a co-writer and instrumentalist. Someone who had sat with Shy Girl for so long and knew the record inside out. 
 
 
 
 Having found a studio that could accommodate his creative process, Ben got to work experimenting with the stems and effects. He brings the rhythms back to the mixing desk, using it like its own instrument to give the tracks that heavy, spatial, dubwise treatment. Taking influence from past pioneers, everything happening on the album was improvised live, with some mixes taking up to 25 attempts to get right from start to finish. As Ben mentions, “I love the freedom and human element of dub mixing and find the limitations of some older productions very inspiring too”.
 
 
 
 Paring the songs back, yet dialling up that bass-weight pressure, Ben creates space for chosen elements and instruments to do the talking. Bringing the drums and bass to the fore, he utilises classic echoes, reverb, and effects, as Hollie’s vocals drift in and out of the mix. 
 
 
 
 The album opens with ‘Shy Dub’, a sound system focussed reimagination of the original album’s title track, heavy on the tape delay with snippets of Hollie reverberating across the drums and bass. Other highlights include ‘Rockaway Dub’, melding the floaty, feel-good lovers rock flavour of the track with a low-end leaning, one-drop groove, and ‘We Share Dub’, a mysticising dub interpretation of Hollie’s celestial Skip Mahoney & The Casuals cover. 
 
 
 
 As the final touch, Ben’s first choice engineer, Josh Hahn, was drafted in on mastering duties. Josh has blessed the tracks with an old-school quality, depth, and roots vibe, mastering from tape in the original time-honoured fashion. This commitment to detail and authenticity completes an album that feels timeless whilst also being full of fresh life and energy. One that would have been equally at home shaking the foundations of Blues parties gone by, as it is sound system sessions of today.
 • Record Store Day 2026 release. Hollie Cook’s sensational album Shy Girl gets the dub reggae treatment from the album’s producer Ben McKone. 
 
 
 
 • Improvised live on the mixing desk, Ben utilises classic dub effects, echo, delay and reverb to push Hollie’s trademark sound into a hypnotising, rhythm and bass-heavy, electronic realm.
 
 
 
 • Pressed on dark green vinyl with A4 sticker sheet insert.

releases.title: The Rhythmatist
releases.label: Demon
releases.details:
*** Never before released on Coloured Vinyl! Limited Translucent Blue Vinyl incl. Signed Art-Print! ***
 
 Reissued on Vinyl for the first time since it’s original release, to celebrate its recent 40th Anniversary in 2025, this groundbreaking project and album is pressed on coloured vinyl for the first time exclusively for Record Store Day. 
 
 Every copy of this vinyl repressing also comes with an exclusive art print signed personally by Stewart Copeland exclusively for Record Store Day!
 
 Following the breakup of the Police, their drummer Stewart Copeland undertook a musical Odessey through the heart of Africa in search of the roots of Rock & Roll. Originally released as both a film, (directed and produced by Jean-Pierre Dutilleux) and album in 1985, ‘The Rhythmatist’ preceded amongst other albums, the release of ‘Graceland’ by Paul Simon which was to follow in 1986.
 
 The album produced by Stewart along with Jeff Seitz, featured the singles ‘Koteja (Oh Bolilla)’ featuring Ray Lema a major figure in world music himself as well as ‘Gong Rock’.
 
 Never repressed since it’s original release the brand new edition comes with exclusive refreshed artwork and is Newly mastered from the original master tapes by Phil Kinrade at Air Studios.

releases.title: The Bootleg Sounds of Marshall Crenshaw: 1984-87
releases.label: Yep Roc Records
releases.details:
Marshall Crenshaw has dug through his archives and curated a compilation of previously unreleased recordings, demos and live songs recorded between 1984 and 1989. Songs include a cover of Buddy Holly’s “That’ll Be the Day,” featuring Garry Tallent and Max Weinberg; demo versions of songs that would appear on his third and fourth studio albums; live recordings from 1986-87; and other lost recordings Marshall unearthed from his studio. This LP is being released for the first time as a Record Store Day Exclusive color pressing of 1,000 copies worldwide.
 
 This is a 2026 Record Store Day exclusive.

releases.title: Disko Mix
releases.label: MOV
releases.details:
140 gram dj friendly audiophile vinyl
 A Dutch boogie treasure
 Remastered audio includes the original „Vokaal“, „Instrumentaal“ and single versions
 Replica artwork of the original sleeve
 Available as a limited edition of 500 individually numbered copies on „Klaver Vier“ green coloured vinyl
 Originally released in 1983 on the small Dutch independent label Klaver Vier, Danny Boy’s “Disko Mix” emerged during the early wave of electro disco, years ahead of its time. With futuristic synths, a steady groove, and Danny Boy’s playful vocal raps celebrating the disco sound, the track captured an unique moment in Dutch club culture. Written by Jolyon Grevelt, son of renowned producer Han Grevelt, “Disko Mix” followed Jolyon’s pioneering success with Repper De Klep, the first Dutch-language rap hit, a localized take on Joe Bataan’s Rap-O Clap-O. 
 While the „Vokaal“version has its charm, it’s the „Instrumentaal“ that truly shines. That version caught the ear of DJs like Young Marco, who featured it on his acclaimed Selectors 002 compilation for Dekmantel in 2017, helping introduce the track to a new international audience.
 Long sought-after by collectors, the original 12” commands high prices on Discogs. Now, this Dutch boogie treasure “Disko Mix” returns for the first time as a remastered reissue, featuring three versions: „Vokaal“, single edit, and the sought after „Instrumentaal“. “Disko Mix” is available as limited edition of 500 individually numbered copies on „Klavier Vier“ green coloured vinyl with faithfully reproduced artwork and brings a cult classic back to the turntables.

releases.title: Grown Up
releases.label: Reservoir Recordings
releases.details: Danny Brown’s „Grown Up“ is a cult-classic hip-hop single that captures everything fans love about the Detroit rapper–wit, grit, and unfiltered personality. Dropped in 2012, the track is built on Party Supplies‘ playful, piano-loop beat that feels like a 90s throwback with just the right amount of bounce. Over it, Danny rewinds to his childhood, spitting about chipped teeth, scuffed sneakers, and the kind of rough edges that shaped his razor-sharp style. The single’s video, starring a pint-sized Danny lookalike raising hell across the city, turned the song into an underground sensation and fan favorite. „Grown Up“ remains one of Brown’s signature moments–equal parts nostalgic storytelling and high-energy fun, proof of his ability to blend classic hip-hop sensibilities with his one-of-a-kind voice. This 7″ includes the instrumental version as the b-side.

releases.title: From Bebop To Blue
releases.label: Culture Factory
releases.details:
Miles Davis – From Bebop To Blue needs no embellishment to impress: this Silver and Black triple vinyl speaks entirely for itself.
 Three LPs retracing the meteoric rise of a young Miles — from “Donna Lee” to “Boplicity,” from “Bags’ Groove” to “So What” and “All Blues.”
 Everything is here: the birth of cool, the modal revolution, the blue nights of Paris.
 The set, dressed in refined metallic Silver Pantone, contains an exclusive text and carefully integrated photos, along with the places, dates, and personnel behind each recording.
 Without trying to commemorate anything, this triple album naturally becomes the essential piece to honor the 100th anniversary Miles Davis would have celebrated in 2026.
 You don’t buy it… you keep it.

releases.title: Odyssey: The Remix Collection
releases.label: Nettwerk Music Group
releases.details:
To celebrate 25 years since its original release, this definitive remix collection brings together Delerium’s most iconic trance reinterpretations from the 2000s — compiled together on vinyl for the very first time.
 
 Featuring legendary remixes including DJ Tiësto’s landmark takes on “Silence” and “Innocente,” alongside contributions from Above & Beyond, Rabbit in the Moon, Matt Darey, and Airscape, this 2LP set captures the ethereal beauty and euphoric energy that defined an era.
 
 Pressed on gold double vinyl and housed in a single sleeve with printed inner sleeves.

releases.title: The Way I Should
releases.label: Yep Roc Records
releases.details:
With The Way I Should, Iris DeMent stepped boldly into new territory, delivering a collection that balanced her fierce lyrical conviction with tender vulnerability. Released in 1996, this third studio album from the revered Americana singer-songwriter expanded on her folk and country roots, blending sharp political commentary with deeply personal storytelling.
 
 Backed by a fuller, more contemporary sound and featuring collaborations with legends like Delbert McClinton and Mark Knopfler, DeMent doesn’t shy away from weighty topics. From government corruption („Wasteland of the Free“) to working-class struggle („Quality Time“), she gives voice to the disillusioned with searing honesty and soulful grit. Merle Haggard lends his iconic vocals to “This Kind of Happy,” bringing a warm, lived-in authenticity that deepens the album’s emotional core.
 
 Yet for all its pointed critique, The Way I Should is just as powerful in its quieter moments. Songs like „When My Mornin’ Comes Around“ and „Keep Me God“ shimmer with grace, hope, and an unwavering moral compass. DeMent’s unmistakable voice anchors every track with a sense of authenticity that’s rare and resonant.
 
 The Way I Should isn’t just an artistic evolution; it’s a fearless statement from a singular voice in American music. Timeless in message and rich in heart, it remains one of DeMent’s most compelling and relevant works.
 
 In celebration of the album’s 30th anniversary, Yep Roc Records is pressing The Way I Should on vinyl for the first time. The album is remastered by Mike Westbrook of Material Mastering and is pressed on Summer Sky color vinyl, limited to 1,000 copies worldwide.

releases.title: The Rescue
releases.label: Demon
releases.details:
*** Never before released on any format! Limited Translucent “Rescue” Red Vinyl! ***
 
 Brand new and exclusive for Record Store Day 2026, a narrated TV soundtrack of the 1965 serial starring William Hartnell as the Doctor. Comprising two episodes, The Powerful Enemy and Desperate Measures, the story features the debut of companion Vicki, played by Maureen O’Brien who now provides newly recorded linking narration and a bonus behind-the-scenes interview.
 
 The Doctor, Ian (William Russell) and Barbara (Jacqueline Hill) discover a crashed spaceship on the planet Dido in the 25th Century. Survivors Vicki and Bennett are menaced by a terrifying native named Koquillion – or are they? The travellers risk their lives to discover the truth.
 
 Sixty years after its original broadcast, The Rescue is presented for the first time on 140g ‘Rescue Red’ translucent vinyl in a beautifully illustrated outer sleeve depicting Koquillion, plus an illustrated inner sleeve which includes full cast and credits.
 
 Track-Listing:
 Side A: The Powerful Enemy
 Side B: Desperate Measures

releases.title: Get Demented
releases.label: Demented Punk
releases.details:
The physical debut of all-new material from the legendary Dr. Demento paired with newly restored and remastered material from 1980 that’s been unavailable and out of print for decades. Pressed on limited edition colored 12-inch vinyl exclusive to RSD.
 
 GET DEMENTED WITH DR. DEMENTO!
 
 Dr. Demento unleashes “Get Demented,” a wild new single that revives the spirit of classic novelty music with a Dr. Seuss-inspired visual style and a wink of pure comic genius.
 
 The legendary Dr. Demento is back to stir up a new wave of madness with his all-new single “Get Demented.“ The world’s most beloved purveyor of mad music and crazy comedy takes the mic himself, leading this wild new original track backed by nerd-rock outfit the Amoeba People. Written especially for Dr. Demento, the song carries forward the tradition of classic novelty music while bringing in sharp, modern themes that fit perfectly in today’s unpredictable times.
 
 Visually, the single’s cover art is just as outrageous as the title track itself. The stunning new Dr. Seuss-inspired cover art was illustrated by Joe Simko, the celebrated lead artist behind Topps’ Garbage Pail Kids and Wacky Packages, with concept and art direction by John Cafiero of Osaka Popstar and Demented Punk. The result blends two unmistakable pop-culture icons, Dr. Seuss and Dr. Demento, into one unforgettable image that captures the gleeful absurdity of the moment.
 
 The new single makes its physical debut with this RSD exclusive release on limited edition 12-inch colored vinyl—also featuring Dr. Demento’s long out of print cover version of the novelty classic “Shaving Cream” on the flip side! Originally released in 1980, Demento’s rendition of “Shaving Cream has been digitally restored and newly remastered in 24 bit from the analog source to be made available once again for the first time in decades!
 
 For more than fifty years, Dr. Demento has been the authority on musical mischief, championing novelty hits and discovering new voices in the art of the absurd. His long-running syndicated radio show, (still available to stream exclusively at DrDemento.com), created an entire genre of comedy music and launched the career of “Weird Al” Yankovic. His influence has earned him honors in the Comedy Music Hall of Fame, the National Radio Hall of Fame, and even a cameo on The Simpsons.
 
 With “Get Demented,” Dr. Demento proves he’s still leading the charge for weirdness in all its forms. It’s a reminder that laughter, satire, and a good hook never go out of style.

releases.title: Live in London 1980
releases.label: Demon
releases.details:
*** Never before released on any format! Limited Orange Double-Vinyl! ***
 First ever release for this incredible live concert from Ian Dury & The Blockheads at London’s Dominion Theatre on Christmas Eve 1980, pressed exclusively for Record Store Day on Orange coloured 2LP. Originally transmitted as a special TV performance for the ‘Old Grey Whistle Test’ on BBC2 TV and for John Peel on BBC Radio 1.
 Following on from the run of singles „Reasons to Be Cheerful, Part 3“, „I Want to Be Straight“ and „Sueperman’s Big Sister“ 1980 saw the release of new album ‘Laughter’ by Ian Dury & The Blockheads. 
 The ‘Laughter’ tour took place in December 1980 and on Christmas Eve Ian Dury & The Blockheads performed at London’s Dominion Theatre live on Radio 1 and on TV via BBC2’s ‘Old Grey Whistle Test’ – introduced on TV by Annie Nightingale and on radio by John Peel.
 With The Blockheads now featuring former Dr Feelgood frontman, Wilko Johnson on guitar taking the place of the now departed Chaz Jankel the live show also features additional musicians Don Cherry (father of Neneh) and Topper Headon (The Clash) in addition to the Blockheads line up of lan Dury, Davey Payne, John Turnbull, Norman Watt-Roy, Mickey Gallagher and Charlie Charles.
 Tracklisting:

 Uncoolohol

 Dance of the Crackpots
 What a Waste
 Hey, Hey, Take Me Away
 Manic Depression (Jimi)

 Oh Mr Peanut
 Hit Me With Your Rhythm Stick
 Sex & Drugs & Rock & Roll

releases.title: Atlantis
releases.label: MOV
releases.details:
180 gram audiophile vinyl
 Gatefold sleeve
 Featuring the epic suite „Atlantis“ and the single „Maybe Tomorrow, Maybe Tonight“
 Includes insert
 Limited edition on turquoise coloured vinyl
 
 Released in 1973, Atlantis is the landmark prog-rock album by Dutch band Earth And Fire. Founded by twin brothers Chris (guitars) and Gerard Koerts (keyboards), with bassist Hans Ziech, drummer Ton v.d. Kleij and female vocalist Jerney Kaagman. The A-side is the full suite „Atlantis“ based on the story of the greedy and corrupt island of civilization, ultimately destroyed by the four elements, fire, water, air and earth. The B-side features the single „Maybe Tomorrow, Maybe Tonight“ which reached top ten positions in both the Netherlands and Belgium, alongside four additional tracks that showcase the band’s melodic range and lyrical depth.
 Atlantis is available as a limited edition on turquoise coloured vinyl, includes an insert with lyrics and is packaged in a gatefold.

releases.title: EV3
releases.label: Real Gone Music
releases.details: Along with TLC, En Vogue was the girl group of the ‘90s. And 1997’s EV3 was the best-selling album of their career, rocketing to #8 on the charts and scoring three hit singles with “Don’t Let Go (Love),” “Whatever,” and “Too Gone, Too Long.” All this in the midst of band turmoil with the departure of Dawn Robinson, who left in the middle of the album sessions (though she still remains on most of the album tracks). EV3 has never been on vinyl, and we’re doing it right, with a remastered double-LP that includes the two Japan-only bonus tracks “It’s About Love” and “Keep Your Money” (exclusive to this Record Store Day vinyl edition) pressed in forest green vinyl housed inside a gatefold jacket. Limited to 1250 copies!

releases.title: Bye Bye Love
releases.label: Culture Factory
releases.details: The Everly Brothers helped shape early rock & roll with their flawless harmonies and unforgettable melodies. This Bye Bye Love compilation gathers their most essential recordings, including “Bye Bye Love,” “Wake Up Little Susie,” “All I Have to Do Is Dream,” “Cathy’s Clown,” “Lucille,” and “Crying in the Rain.” Fully remastered for optimal sound, every track highlights the duo’s unique blend of country, pop, and rock.

releases.title: Digimortal
releases.label: Real Gone Music
releases.details: Fear Factory’s 2001 release Digimortal went Top 40, but it’s only come out in Germany on vinyl back in 2007. And its reissue now couldn’t be more timely. Another in a string of concept albums that began with Demanufacture and continued with Obsolete, “Digimortal” was short for “Digital Mortality,” presciently exploring the theme of man and machine melding into one (spoiler: it doesn’t end well). Musically, the band simplified its sound and added a touch more melody, but make no mistake: this is nu metal/death metal at its most intense, with an interesting techno overlay. Maybe “cybercore” would be the best term to describe this album, now coming out on its 25th anniversary for Record Store Day in an expanded edition featuring four bonus tracks never before on vinyl and exclusive to this Record Store Day edition, remastered for the format, pressed on black & blue splatter vinyl, and housed in a gatefold jacket. Limited to 2000 copies, and reissued with the full support of the band!

releases.title: Sabbath Fleddy Sabbath
releases.label: MOV
releases.details:
180 gram audiophile vinyl
 Inclusief insert met lyrics
 Bevat de singles “Stop!”, “Beest” en “De Hel Niet Gezien”
 Bereikte de 2e plaats in de Belgische nationale hitlijsten
 Gelimiteerde oplage van 500 genummerde exemplaren op transparant roodgekleurd vinyl
 
 Sabbath Fleddy Sabbath is het derde studioalbum van de Belgische band Fleddy Melculy, origineel uitgebracht in 2020. De Vlaamse metalband werd opgericht in 2016 door Jeroen Camerlynck als een grap, maar is uitgegroeid tot een band die in de afgelopen jaren meer dan honderden shows heeft gespeeld in de Benelux. Het album bereikte #2 in de Belgische nationale albumcharts en bevat de singles „Stop!“, „Beest“ en „De Hel Niet Gezien.“ Voor Record Store Day wordt het album nu opnieuw uitgebracht als gelimiteerde versie.
 Sabbath Fleddy Sabbath is verkrijgbaar als gelimiteerde oplage van 500 genummerde exemplaren op transparant roodgekleurd vinyl en bevat een insert met lyrics.

releases.title: Brilliant Mind (half-half yellow + red)
releases.label: MOV
releases.details:
140 gram vinyl
 First reissue of this cult new wave classic 
 Available as a 40th anniversary edition of 500 numbered copies on half yellow and half red coloured vinyl
 
 Furniture is British new wave band active between 1979 and 1991, but were far more eclectic than you’d think, incorporating jazz, blues and post-punk sounds as well. They are noted both for their poetic storytelling and high-quality productions as for the numerous setbacks they experienced. These setbacks ultimately prevented them from making their big break, making them a big what-if of the burgeoning English new wave scene. 
 The band’s 1986 single Brilliant Mind eventually reached number 21 on the UK Singles Chart and remains their only entry on it. Writer and vocalist Jim Irvin recalled that the chorus came to him on the bus, just after registering for unemployment benefits. It became the first single of their second album The Wrong People, which became a cult classic in later years. Now, on its 40th anniversary, we are reissuing the 12″ single in its original form.
 Brilliant Mind is available as a 40th anniversary limited edition on half yellow and half red coloured vinyl.

releases.title: Live From The Camden Palace
releases.label: Culture Factory
releases.details: GIRLSCHOOL is the longest running all-female rock band still active after more than 40 years. They maintain a worldwide cult following and are an inspiration for many female rock musicians. Original members Kim McAuliffe, Denise Dufort, and long-time member Jackie Chambers are still in the band. Live fron the Camden Palace was recorded in 1984 & is part of „The Live from London“ series. It has never been released on vinyl before.

releases.title: Zwollywood (Live 1980)
releases.label: MOV
releases.details:
180 gram audiophile vinyl
 First time on vinyl
 Long lost & forgotten gig from 1980
 Limited edition of 1500 individually numbered copies on blue coloured vinyl
 
 On a cold night in December 1980, 
 3.000 spectators witnessed one to last gigs of Golden Earring’s tour to promote their album Prisoner Of The Night.
 Several shows were recorded during this tour including this one in Zwolle., the band’s archivist Wouter Bessels did some extensive research and the long lost Zwolle tape was found. The energy and vibe of these recordings was simply irresistible. We couldn’t put
 these tapes back on the drawer, never to be played again.
 So here you go, especially for RSD. 
 Zwollywood, an ‘official bootleg style’ double album by Holland’s finest; Golden Earring!
 This is the Earring at their finest. Live, pure & raw

releases.title: Flying Teapot
releases.label: Charly
releases.details:
GONG – Flying Teapot (Half-Speed Master Deluxe Edition)
 
 Remastered from the original BYG Records tapes and cut for the first time ever at half-speed at the UK’s world-famous Stardelta Studios by Grammy Award–winning mastering engineer Lewis Hopkin, this exclusive RSD 2026 edition features a deluxe gatefold sleeve, archival artwork, and a 16-page booklet exploring the storytelling and mythology of the beloved Radio Gnome Invisible saga. Released under BYG Records – the original label that recorded the album before licensing it to Virgin – this definitive deluxe reissue delivers the best sound quality Flying Teapot has ever had: a true cosmic upgrade for Gong’s mind-bending masterpiece.
 
 Originally unleashed in 1973, Flying Teapot kicked off the eccentric Radio Gnome Invisible trilogy, introducing the wild, otherworldly universe of Gong. Here reside the Pot Head Pixies, space-faring creatures who ride interstellar teapots and transmit transcendent messages via Radio Gnome Invisible. At its core, the album is a surreal fusion of psychedelia, jazz improvisation, and anarchic humour, propelled by Daevid Allen’s visionary madness.
 
 Featuring the cult anthems “Radio Gnome Invisible,” “Flying Teapot,” and “Zero the Hero,” this edition resurrects Gong’s signature blend of absurdity and brilliance – now with stunning clarity that reveals every swirl of synth, every playful whisper, every glimmer of cosmic chaos.
 
 Half-speed mastered. Fully teapot-powered.
 Out exclusively for Record Store Day 2026.

releases.title: Were „The Watchtowers“
releases.label: Yep Roc Records
releases.details: Were „The Watchtowers“ is the final recordings of Dallas Good of The Sadies, recorded prior to his unexpected passing in February 2022. This collaboration between Good and Richard Reed Parry of Arcade Fire (originally calling their duo “The Watchtowers“) had slowly been written and recorded over the course of a decade whenever the two had a spare weekend. “It has been the slowest moving musical endeavour of my entire life,” Parry says. “We didn’t plan to do it this way, it’s just how it happened. Tiny, joyous flourishes of activity a couple times a year for over a decade.” Many of Good’s collaborators make guest appearances on the album, including Neko Case, Kurt Vile, Yo La Tengo, Jim Jarmusch, John Doe, Jon Spencer, Scott McCaughey, Gary Louris and Margaret Atwood. The album explores the cosmic, psychedelic Americana sounds that The Sadies perfected on 2022’s Colder Streams that featured Parry in the producer’s chair. The final track on the album „Not in This World“ boasts a chorus of over 500 of Dallas‘ friends and fans from around the world singing together on Dallas‘ final piece of recorded music. The album is pressed on white vinyl and limited to 1,000 copies worldwide and is exclusively available first at Record Store Day 2026.

releases.title: The Hickey Underworld
releases.label: V2 Records
releases.details: Reissue of The Hickey Underworld’s self-titled debut album from 2004, including a 7 inch with outtakes (‚Sick of Boys“ and „Blonde Fire“)

releases.title: Crisus Time
releases.label: Charly
releases.details:
The mic reggae master returns! For the first time ever, I-Roy’s Crisus Time comes back to wax – fully remastered and restored to mark 50 years since its original release in 1976. A cornerstone of roots DJ culture, this long-lost treasure now steps forward again in a special anniversary edition made for true reggae heads and vinyl collectors.
 
 This exclusive Record Store Day release features a faithful replica of the original 1976 sleeve, plus a new printed inner sleeve with fresh liner notes by acclaimed reggae writer John Masouri and a full-page black-and-white photo of the man I-Roy – a fitting tribute to one of Jamaica’s most original voices.
 
 On Crisus Time, I-Roy delivers his trademark mix of wisdom, humor, and rebel poetry. From the streetwise sermons of “Hypocrite Blackout” and “Love Your Neighbor” to the Rasta calls of “African Tak” and “Don’t Touch I Man Locks,” he turns everyday truth into lyrical fire. Riding deep dub rhythms, his voice moves between meditation and proclamation – pure word, sound, and power.
 
 A true monument of the reggae DJ era, Crisus Time shines again – 50 years on – a timeless celebration of rhythm, roots, and I-Roy’s enduring message.

releases.title: Tampert
releases.label: MOV
releases.details:
180 grams audiofiel vinyl
 Komt met ansichtkaart en postzegel gesigneerd en ontworpen door Michiel Romeyn 
 Beschikbaar op kunstgebitroze vinyl (in een Opel Kadett-grijze hoes) met een oplage van 500 stuks
 Jiskefet is one of the Netherlands‘ most famous comedy trios, consisting of Kees Prins, Michiel Romeyn and Herman Koch. They operated within the genres of absurdism, satire and improvisation and were active between 1990 and 2005. Most sketches are in Dutch, but occasionally in English as well, such as their famous sketch „English Sports“, a Monty Python-esque bit that playfully mocking traditional British field sports such as cricket and polo. 
 Another famous sketch of the trio is „Tampert“ which is a satirical take on Derrick, a typical German crime drama from the 1980s. In 1997 the trio produced a very limited private pressing of its theme song with „Technofax“ on the B-side, a spoof of Kraftwerk. The record wasn’t widely distributed and not many copies have survived, making it a very obscure item, and we are therefore very proud to re-release this piece of Dutch comedy heritage on Music on Vinyl.
 Tampert is available as a limited edition of 500 copies on pink „denture“-coloured vinyl and comes with a signed postcard with stamp designed by Michiel Romeyn.
 
 ——————
 
 Jiskefet was een Nederlandse humoristische absurdistisch-satirische serie uitgezonden gemaakt door misschien wel het meest bekende komedietrio van Nederland: Kees Prins, Michiel Romeyn, en Herman Koch. De afleveringen bestonden veelal uit losse sketches waarvan velen er een iconische status hebben verworven, zoals Debiteuren Crediteuren, De Lullo’s, en Multilul.
 In die categorie valt ook Tampert, een persiflage van de Duitse Krimi Derrick, vernoemd naar hoofdrolspeler Horst Tappert. Hierin speelt Herman Koch de lijzige hoofdinspecteur Tampert die samen met zijn partner Freddy (Michiel Romeyn) in het steenkolenduits zaken oplost, onder het genot van „ein tropical drink“. 
 Rondom het televisiedebuut van Tampert in 1997 hebben de heren van Jiskefet de titelsong van Tampert geperst op een extreem gelimiteerde 12″, met op de B-kant de „ausgeräckter mix“ van Technofax, een persiflage van Kraftwerk. Originele kopietjes zijn bijna niet meer te vinden en Music On Vinyl presenteert daarom met gepaste trots de eerste officiële reissue. 
 Tampert is beschikbaar op kunstgebitroze vinyl (in een Opel Kadett-grijze hoes) met een oplage van 500 stuks en wordt geleverd met een gesigneerde ansichtkaart met postzegel ontworpen door Michiel Romeyn.

releases.title: France 1965: The Complete Concerts
releases.label: Charly
releases.details:
John Coltrane Quartet – France 1965: The Complete Concerts (4LP Set Gatefold Sleeve – Centenary Edition)
 
 Marking 100 years since Coltrane’s birth, Charly Records presents France 1965: The Complete Concerts – a landmark 4LP set housed in a gatefold package featuring photographs, a concert poster, and new liner notes. This historic collection brings together, for the first time ever, the complete series of performances by the revered John Coltrane Quartet in France in July 1965, capturing the original “classic quartet” lineup – John Coltrane (tenor saxophone), McCoy Tyner (piano), Jimmy Garrison (bass), and Elvin Jones (drums) – during their final European tour together.
 
 A Historic Moment in Jazz History
 
 In July 1965, Coltrane and his group were booked for three extraordinary performances in France:
 
 – July 26 — International Jazz Festival, Juan-les-Pins, Antibes
 – July 27 — International Jazz Festival, Juan-les-Pins, Antibes
 – July 28 — Salle Pleyel, Paris
 
 On July 26, the quartet performed the only complete live version of A Love Supreme ever known to have been played by the original lineup. Previously believed lost to time, the Charly Records archivists have painstakingly recovered and restored the full performance, long thought to survive only in a brief French TV excerpt.
 
 A Love Supreme – Reborn
 
 Recorded just seven months after Coltrane entered Rudy Van Gelder’s studio to record A Love Supreme (December 9, 1964), these performances offer a transcendent continuation of that spiritual masterpiece.
 Coltrane described A Love Supreme as an offering of faith – “a humble attempt to say ‘thank you, God.’” In France, that devotion reached the stage: extended improvisations, spiritual intensity, and collective telepathy between four musicians at their creative and emotional peak.
 
 The Complete French Tour – Finally United
 
 While fragments of these concerts have appeared over the years on scattered CD and vinyl releases, France 1965: The Complete Concerts marks the first time every note from this historic tour is presented together and in full fidelity.
 
 Across four LPs, listeners will experience:
 – The complete “A Love Supreme” suite, performed live for the first and only time.
 – Powerful renditions of “Naima,” “My Favorite Things,” “Impressions,” “Ascension,” and “Afro Blue.”
 – Coltrane’s bold reinterpretations of familiar material as he edged toward the free jazz revolution that would define his final years.
 
 An Essential Bridge Between Eras
 
 These recordings document Coltrane’s crucial transitional phase – balancing the lyricism and structure of his early work with the boundless exploration that would characterize his late period with Pharoah Sanders and Alice Coltrane.
 
 The result is an unprecedented portrait of an artist and ensemble on the threshold of transformation – spiritually charged, deeply focused, and utterly fearless.
 A significant archival jazz release – a once-lost moment in history, released in celebration of Coltrane’s centenary.

releases.title: Coffret Souvenir
releases.label: Culture Factory
releases.details: This legendary box set by Johnny Hallyday, originally released in 1968 and never reissued since, returns in a faithful restored edition. Finding this set complete with its original booklet and insert has become extremely rare. Both elements are reproduced exactly as issued, preserving every visual and editorial detail. More than a reissue, this is a true time capsule — a collector’s piece that revives a defining moment in rock history.

releases.title: Saturday Teenage Kick
releases.label: Real Gone Music
releases.details: By the time he reached 30, Tom Holkenborg had already produced and played with the Dutch new wave band Weekend at Waikiki, formed an industrial rock group (Nerve) that recorded two albums, produced bands like Sepultura and Fear Factory, and licensed his own electronic synth creations for video games. But all of that was mere prelude for what was about to unfold; for in 1997, Holkenborg adopted his Junkie XL persona and embarked on a journey that was to wind up with his composing wildly acclaimed film scores for films like Mad Max: Fury Road, 300: Rise of an Empire, Divergent, and Deadpool. But it all got started with this album, Saturday Teenage Kick, the first project released under the Junkie XL moniker and to this day a groundbreaking blend of rock and electronica. Never before released on vinyl outside of his native Netherlands and featuring the album-closing track “Future in Computer Hell”/”Mulu” that has never appeared on vinyl, it appears here in a double sea blue pressing remastered for the format and limited to 1500 copies, exclusive for Record Store Day.

releases.title: Big Fig Wasp
releases.label: Having Fun
releases.details:
Having Fun Records continues its King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard official bootleg series with a bug/bee shaped record including the songs Big Fig Wasp, Superbug, Grow Wings and Fly, and Great Chain of Being compiled from live performances. $1 from every record sold will benefit pollinator charities. Save the bees! 
 
 This is a 2026 Record Store Day Release.

releases.title: Not An Addict
releases.label: MOV
releases.details:
180 gram audiophile vinyl
 Deluxe sleeve with linen laminate finish
 The legendary breakthrough single of the Belgian rock band
 Featuring four songs live at Pinkpop Festival 1996
 Available on vinyl for the first time
 Limited edition of 750 numbered copies on blue splattered vinyl
 
 
 In 1996, Belgian band K’s Choice stormed the music charts worldwide. Their single „Not An Addict“ appeared on hit lists in Australia, the US, Canada and Europe. To celebrate Record Store Day, the original single will be released on 12″. This one-time-only reissue will include all the B-sides that appeared on different versions of the CD single, including four songs from the 1996 Pinkpop live recording. Not An Addict is available as a limited edition on blue splattered vinyl.

releases.title: Modo Livre
releases.label: MOV
releases.details:
180 gram audiophile vinyl
 Includes booklet with photos and lyrics
 An extremely hard to find MPB holy grail 
 Available on vinyl for the first time in over 20 years 
 With legendary guest musicians Caetano Veloso and Arthur Verocai among others
 Featuring „Abre Alas“
 Available as a limited edition of 750 numbered copies on translucent blue coloured vinyl
 
 
 Ivan Lins is a Latin Grammy-winning Brazilian musician who has been a prolific performer and songwriter of MPB (Música Popular Brasileira) and jazz for over fifty years. His first hit was Madalena in 1970, written for Elis Regina, and his song „Love Dance“ („Lembrança“) has been recorded by countless jazz artist including Kenny Burrell, Sarah Vaughan, Betty Carter, Nancy Wilson and George Benson.
 Modo Livre is his fourth album and mostly features songs written by Lins himself, showcasing his strength as songwriter, but features many influential musicians from that era such as Caetano Veloso, Wagner Tiso and Robertinho. Also featured on guitar, arrangement and conducting duties is MPB legend Arthur Verocai.
 Over the years the record amassed somewhat of a cult following making it extremely hard to find so we’re proud to make this Brazilian essential available again for the first time in over 20 years. 
 Modo Livre is available as a limited edition of 750 numbered copies on translucent blue coloured vinyl.

releases.title: Hard Rock Hallelujah
releases.label: MOV
releases.details:
140 gram vinyl
 The 2006 winner of the Eurovision Song Contest
 Exclusive UV print on B-side
 Available on vinyl for the first time
 20th anniversary edition of 666 copies
 
 Twenty years ago, the unimaginable happened: a rock band won the Eurovision Song Contest. But the winners, the Finnish hard rock band Lordi, were far from your average rock band. They shocked the world with their extreme horror aesthetic, but the catchiness of their song „Hard Rock Hallelujah“ was undeniable. It stormed the charts throughout Europe, reaching the Top 5 in Germany, Austria, Belgium and Ireland.
 Even 20 years on, the song remains unique among all the contest winners, and fans still talk about it every year as one of the best of all time. Lordi are still going strong, touring the world with their spectacular live show and releasing new albums almost every year, while still finding new ways to keep their sound and aesthetic vibrant. The band is a household name in the metal scene and is loved by many Eurovision fans, a unique combination. 
 To celebrate the 20th anniversary, Hard Rock Hallelujah is available as a limited edition of 666 copies and will have an unique UV print on the B-side.

releases.title: We Can Be Worster
releases.label: Manic Merch
releases.details:
Start spreadin‘ the news: New York City’s premier punk rockers, the Lunachicks, have returned to rally the freaks, liberate ladyparts, and save the goddamn world. Following the release of their acclaimed memoir Fallopian Rhapsody (Hachette Books), the band stormed back with their first live shows in 17 years–headlining the main stage at Punk Rock Bowling 2021, followed by sold-out shows at Webster Hall and a slot in the CBGB Fest lineup with Iggy Pop.
 
 From the stage to the page, the Lunachicks‘ story continues with the upcoming documentary Pretty Ugly: The Story of the Lunachicks, directed by Ilya Chaiken and slated for theatrical release in spring 2026, along with their first-ever best-of compilation, We Can Be Worster.
 
 Throughout the ’90s and early ’00s, the Lunachicks‘ hard-hitting hooks, gritty guitars, and pounding beats earned them a cult following stretching from the Bowery to Tokyo. Formed as teenagers at NYC’s famed LaGuardia High School, the band set out to conquer the world like their idols The Ramones, Black Sabbath, Kiss, The Clash, and Blondie. After cutting their teeth at legendary clubs like CBGB and The Limelight, they caught the attention of Kim Gordon and Thurston Moore of Sonic Youth, leading to their 1990 debut Babysitters on Acid on London’s Blast First Records.
 
 With each release, the Lunachicks gleefully dumped technicolor chaos on propriety, morality, and the patriarchy–but it was their live shows that cemented their legacy. A riot of wigs, costumes, makeup, and blaring guitars, their performances were equal parts spectacle, satire, and sheer musical power.
 
 Lunachicks released five studio albums, a live record, countless singles and videos, and appeared in films and compilations. They’ve shared stages with The Ramones, Iggy Pop, Joan Jett, No Doubt, Rancid, NOFX, Buzzcocks, and The Go-Go’s.
 
 Today, Theo (vocals), Gina (guitar), Squid (bass), and Chip (drums) remain a fearless, ferocious quartet-still loud, smart, and gloriously unhinged.

releases.title: Good Morning It’s Now Tomorrow
releases.label: Nettwerk Music Group
releases.details:
To celebrate the 5th anniversary of ‚Good Morning It’s Now Tomorrow‘, British-Canadian singer-songwriter Matt Maltese presents this special 2LP collector’s edition, uniting his acclaimed third studio album with the ‚madhouse‘ and ‚Quiet Recordings‘ EPs — the latter appearing on vinyl for the first time, exclusively for Record Store Day.
 Pressed on ultra-clear vinyl and housed in a deluxe gatefold sleeve, this edition showcases the songwriting prowess that has made Maltese one of the UK’s most distinctive voices. From the lush pop melancholy of ‚Good Morning It’s Now Tomorrow‘ to the intimate reimaginings of ‚Quiet Recordings‘, the depth and range of Maltese’s artistry are apparent throughout.

releases.title: Live at Albert Hall Manchester
releases.label: Chrysalis Frontline
releases.details: Laura Marling – Patterns In Repeat (Live From Albert Hall, Manchester) is an exclusive RSD26 release featuring the full live recordings from Laura’s sold-out Patterns In Repeat shows in 2025, featuring the album performed live in full with a string quartet and choir, as well as an opening acoustic solo set with Laura. This release is a gatefold double LP, with limited edition blue transparent vinyl and exclusive photo of Laura performing live inside. This live album features tracks from the critically acclaimed albums including Songs For Our Daughter, I Speak Because I Can and most recent – Patterns in Repeat. Patterns in Repeat, Laura Marling’s eighth studio album was written following the birth of her daughter in 2023 and finds Laura reflecting on her motherhood experience as well as more broadly diving deeper into her reckoning with the ideas and behaviours we pass down through family over generations. „An expert songwriter at the top of her game“ – New York Times

releases.title: Passing Stranger
releases.label: Shedio Records
releases.details:
Black Vinyl 180g // „The 20th Anniversary of Scott Matthews‘ debut album ‚Passing Stranger‘ sees the artist release this much loved album for the first time ever on vinyl.
 
 With noted hints of Neil Finn, Thom Yorke & Jeff Buckley, the album was described as a „“gem of an album““ by the BBC on release, and features the track ‚Elusive‘, which won the the 2007 Ivor Novello Award for „“Best Song Musically and Lyrically”.“

releases.title: Welcome To My Dream (35th Anniversary Expanded Edition)

 This 35th Anniversary Expanded Edition celebrates MC 900 Ft. Jesus’s genre-defying album with a tracklisting personally curated by Mark Griffin. Featuring Griffin’s own liner notes and early demos pressed on vinyl for the first time, this release shines new light on a record that still sounds boldly ahead of its time. This best of album is a tribute to the bands tremendous achievements over the years. The album covers the years form 1981 through 1987. It has never been released on vinyl.

releases.title: Live & Ready The Best of MSG Live 1980 – 1984
releases.label: Chrysalis Records
releases.details: Experience the raw power and precision of one of rock’s most influential guitarists with this essential live LP compilation from the formative years of the Michael Schenker Group. Drawing from electrifying performances between 1980 and 1984, this release captures MSG at their most dynamic, showcasing Michael Schenker’s unmistakable tone, melodic fire, and commanding stage presence. Highlights include selections from the band’s explosive early tours, legendary Japanese performances, and celebrated UK shows that cemented MSG’s reputation as a premier live act. Featuring standout moments from Manchester Apollo (1980), Nippon Budokan, Tokyo (1981), Hammersmith Odeon, London (1983), and Seibu Stadium, Tokyo (1984), this compilation distils the energy of these iconic concerts into a cohesive vinyl listening experience. Several performances were previously unavailable on vinyl, making this a must-have for collectors. Expertly remastered at AIR Mastering, the audio delivers maximum impact while preserving the authenticity of the original live recordings. Pressed on high-quality vinyl and presented in premium packaging, this LP is designed to appeal to both long-time MSG fans and vinyl enthusiasts seeking classic hard rock and melodic metal at its peak. A powerful snapshot of a defining era, this release stands as a testament to Michael Schenker’s enduring legacy and the Michael Schenker Group’s status as a formidable live force. The Michael Schenker Group – Live And Ready – The Best of MSG Live 1980 – 1984: LP Splatter Vinyl remastered at AIR Mastering.

releases.title: The Mighty Rootsmen Strike Back
releases.label: Bulletproof
releases.details:
Following the release of Hollie Cook’s fifth studio album, Shy Girl, and her return to Mr Bongo 15 years after her debut, the album’s producer Ben McKone reconstructs the recordings into a newly cut dubwise release. Made for Record Store Day 2026, Ben strips back the productions in vintage dub reggae style. Crafted on an analogue mixing desk, he weaves in delays, echoes, and reverb to push Hollie’s trademark sound into a hypnotising, rhythm and bass-heavy, electronic realm.
 
 
 
 Rich in the tradition of reggae albums from the late ‘60s onwards, Hollie wanted to reimagine Shy Girl through a dub-focused lens. Evidently, only one person seemed the perfect fit to do so: Ben McKone of the General Roots, who was the producer of Shy Girl and featured heavily across the album as a co-writer and instrumentalist. Someone who had sat with Shy Girl for so long and knew the record inside out. 
 
 
 
 Having found a studio that could accommodate his creative process, Ben got to work experimenting with the stems and effects. He brings the rhythms back to the mixing desk, using it like its own instrument to give the tracks that heavy, spatial, dubwise treatment. Taking influence from past pioneers, everything happening on the album was improvised live, with some mixes taking up to 25 attempts to get right from start to finish. As Ben mentions, “I love the freedom and human element of dub mixing and find the limitations of some older productions very inspiring too”.
 
 
 
 Paring the songs back, yet dialling up that bass-weight pressure, Ben creates space for chosen elements and instruments to do the talking. Bringing the drums and bass to the fore, he utilises classic echoes, reverb, and effects, as Hollie’s vocals drift in and out of the mix. 
 
 
 
 The album opens with ‘Shy Dub’, a sound system focussed reimagination of the original album’s title track, heavy on the tape delay with snippets of Hollie reverberating across the drums and bass. Other highlights include ‘Rockaway Dub’, melding the floaty, feel-good lovers rock flavour of the track with a low-end leaning, one-drop groove, and ‘We Share Dub’, a mysticising dub interpretation of Hollie’s celestial Skip Mahoney & The Casuals cover. 
 
 
 
 As the final touch, Ben’s first choice engineer, Josh Hahn, was drafted in on mastering duties. Josh has blessed the tracks with an old-school quality, depth, and roots vibe, mastering from tape in the original time-honoured fashion. This commitment to detail and authenticity completes an album that feels timeless whilst also being full of fresh life and energy. One that would have been equally at home shaking the foundations of Blues parties gone by, as it is sound system sessions of today.
 • Record Store Day 2026 release. Hollie Cook’s sensational album Shy Girl gets the dub reggae treatment from the album’s producer Ben McKone. 
 
 
 
 • Improvised live on the mixing desk, Ben utilises classic dub effects, echo, delay and reverb to push Hollie’s trademark sound into a hypnotising, rhythm and bass-heavy, electronic realm.
 
 
 
 • Pressed on dark green vinyl with A4 sticker sheet insert.

Out of print for over 40 years, this LP Originally released on Mingus’ own Jazz Work Shop Records. Carefully Remastered by five-time Grammy Award Winning Engineer Michael Graves with Vinyl Mastering by Jeff Powell. This RSD Exclusive version will be Pressed on 180 Gram vinyl on an exclusive color available only to RSD enthusiasts.
 Original artwork meticulously restored and reproduced is produced in conjunction with Jazz Workshop Inc., the Charles Mingus Estate. This legendary recording features a powerhouse sextet featuring Eric Dolphy, Johnny Coles, and Jaki Byard. Blending blues, explosive swing, and avant-garde bursts, this high-wire performance captures Mingus at his boldest — uncompromising, urgent, and alive with possibility.

releases.title: People Get Ready
releases.label: Yep Roc Records
releases.details:
The Mooney Suzuki’s landmark debut People Get Ready is getting the deluxe treatment for its 25th anniversary! The full album is completely remastered and includes the rarity „I’m Not Talkin'“ on the first disc (pressed on yellow vinyl), with a second disc containing the band’s 1999 concert at The Cooler in NYC, a blistering, sweat-soaked performance never before released, pressed on white & black vinyl. Housed in a gatefold sleeve with all-new artwork and upgraded packaging, this seminal 2000s album has never sounded better.
 
 Long hailed as one of the ignition sparks of the early-2000s garage-rock revival, People Get Ready didn’t just introduce The Mooney Suzuki, it helped define the sound and swagger of a scene that would soon reshape rock music. Its explosive energy, razor-wire riffs, and unfiltered urgency were a blueprint for a generation of bands emerging from New York’s downtown clubs. Members of The Strokes, Yeah Yeah Yeahs, and other contemporaries have spoken about the electric atmosphere of the band, and People Get Ready stands as one of the records that proved a new wave of rock was not only possible, but inevitable. The Mooney Suzuki’s raw, soul-infused attack set a tone that their peers absorbed, expanded, and carried into the global spotlight.
 
 This is a 2026 Record Store Day Release.

releases.title: Remix The Chaos (Volume 1)
releases.label: 100% Records
releases.details:
Remixes of tracks from Morcheeba’s latest studio album by a selection of the very best in the electronic scene. Morcheeba unveil Remix The Chaos: Volume 1, the first instalment in a three-part remix series drawn from their 11th studio album, Escape The Chaos (2025). 
 
 Spanning four tracks per volume, the project brings together an eclectic, global roster of electronic producers, each offering a distinct reimagining of Morcheeba’s unmistakable sound. Multi-genre and far-reaching, the series expands further into the rich sonic world the band have built over the past few decades, pushing their music into bold, contemporary electronic territory. Volume 1 features remixes from Paula Tape, the Chilean superstar producer, recent Mixmag cover star and one of electronic music’s most exciting names heading into 2026; Trance Wax (a.k.a. Ejeca), the prolific Belfast producer specialising in high-energy breakbeat and trance-leaning remixes; Frazer Ray, the London-based underground force known for UK bass, breaks and garage; and Brothers Counsell, a side project from the formidable Joy Anonymous. 
 
 Together, the tracks form a journey of dancefloor-ready hard hitters, powered by Morcheeba’s iconic vocals and signature guitar lines. Pressed on limited edition traffic light red vinyl, Remix The Chaos: Volume 1 comes with deep-cut grooves designed to hit just as hard on a club sound system as they do from the comfort of your living room.

releases.title: Body Of Song
releases.label: Yep Roc Records
releases.details:
To celebrate the 20th anniversary of Bob Mould’s, Body of Song, Yep Roc Records is releasing an expanded edition of this album on peach color vinyl, and adding six bonus tracks to the original album. The bonus tracks originally appeared on the 2-CD deluxe, limited edition version of the album, but have never been available on vinyl until now.
 
 This is a 2026 Record Store Day Release.

releases.title: Of Queues And Cures
releases.label: Charly
releases.details:
National Health – Of Queues and Cures
 First-ever vinyl reissue • Half-speed mastered
 
 Of Queues and Cures, National Health’s remarkable second album, is presented for the first time ever as a half-speed mastered vinyl edition, offering an unparalleled listening experience that reveals new depth and detail in every note. A cornerstone of the Canterbury scene, the album stands as one of its most adventurous and quintessential works – a dazzling display of wit, complexity, and musical interplay.
 
 Following the success of last year’s Record Store Day release of their eponymous debut National Health, this long-awaited reissue celebrates the band’s singular creativity and enduring influence in progressive music.
 
 Building on the group’s distinctive fusion of jazz sophistication and progressive experimentation, Of Queues and Cures captures National Health at the peak of their creative powers. The album overflows with inventiveness, sly humour, and dazzling musicianship, unfolding through intricate yet beautifully structured compositions that showcase the band’s unmatched interplay.
 
 Each track unveils a different atmosphere – complex yet melodic, daring yet elegant. Dave Stewart, Phil Miller, and John Greaves deliver performances of exceptional nuance, anchored by Pip Pyle’s thunderous drumming. The album also features inspired contributions from Canterbury stalwarts Jimmy Hastings and Peter Blegvad, enriching its sonic palette even further.
 
 Of Queues and Cures remains a jewel of the Canterbury sound – a record that continues to mesmerize and inspire open-minded listeners nearly five decades after its release. This new half-speed master edition allows the album’s brilliance to shine as never before, reaffirming its place among the great works of progressive music.

releases.title: Good Boy / Good Girl
releases.label: Nettwerk Music Group
releases.details: Paris Paloma makes her RSD debut with an exclusive 7” double sided vinyl. A beautifully curated release featuring ‘Good Boy’ and ‘Good Girl’ – this will be the first time these two tracks have been available on vinyl. With an eco-friendly Lavender coloured vinyl disc, hand drawn label artwork by Paris herself, a spoken word introduction to ‘Good Boy’ from Dame Emma Thompson, and never before seen artwork for ‘Good Girl’; this is a real treasure for both Paris Paloma fans and the perfect introduction for a new discovery!

releases.title: No Lube So Rude
releases.label: Kill Rock Stars
releases.details:
A brash, unapologetic blend of electronic, dance, punk, industrial, and pop music, No Lube So Rude exists at the intersection of the personal and the political, where the body serves not only as a sexual and spiritual vessel, but also as the front line in a battle for basic human rights. Peaches’ lyrics are bawdy and explicit here, laced with biting sarcasm and clever wordplay, but they’re also surprisingly vulnerable, offering up a candid look in the mirror from a post-menopausal queer icon reckoning with a society that’s come to expect silence, if not outright erasure. The result is a deliberately provocative exploration of identity, sexuality, and bodily autonomy from a trailblazer, a singular work of emotional and sonic alchemy that balances the poetic and the profane in equal measure as it transforms all the friction and frustration of modern life into joy and transcendence. 
 
 This is a 2026 Record Store Day release.

releases.title: Love Affair (expanded edition)
releases.label: MOV
releases.details:
180 gram audiophile vinyl 
 Expanded edition 
 First time on vinyl
 Exclusive liner notes by Laurence Cane-Honeysett
 Limited edition of 750 individually numbered copies on red translucent coloured vinyl
 
 
 As 1978 drew to a close, an exciting young artist with a lilting, mellifluous voice burst onto the British music scene,
 as her single, ‘Walk Away’, made its swift journey to the top of the nation’s reggae charts. And yet few or any of
 those who bought the sweetly-rendered record at the time could have been aware that despite her tender age,
 Marie Pierre was in fact already something of a seasoned professional whose experience both in the recording
 studio and on the live scene stretched back years.
 In time, her hit record, produced by the UK’s premier reggae producer, Dennis ‘Blackbeard’ Bovell, would
 become a staple of the lovers rock sound and when, over the months that immediately followed its release, a
 number of similarly impressive singles further demonstrated the extent of her talent.
 This expanded version of Marie’s Love Affair – her one and only album to date- presents her entire Trojan output along with a further
 two Dennis Bovell-produced tracks, released shortly before and after her all-too-brief spell with the company.
 This long overdue deluxe version is now available as limited edition of 750 individually numbered copies on red translucent coloured vinyl

releases.title: Live At The 100 Club
releases.label: The Turning Point
releases.details: Vinyl debut for live album from the late legendary Northern Soul artist Nolan Porter, with Stone Foundation as his backing band. The late Northen Soul legend Nolan Porter joined forces with UK-based soul heroes Stone Foundation in 2011 for a series of landmark gigs. For the first time on vinyl, the performance at London’s legendary 100 Club is now available for Record Store Day. Pressed on white vinyl, the performance boasts Nolan’s timeless classics Keep On Keepin’ On and If I Could Only Be Sure alongside other favourites from his career, as well as Stone Foundation’s very own track Tracing Paper. The release captures a thrilling collaboration at a time before Stone Foundation would themselves go on to considerable success, and is a reminder of a celebratory night that lives long in the memory of all who were lucky enough to be present.

This triple LP, made up exclusively of 1961 recordings, gives pride of place to the studio sessions, capturing Elvis free, intense, spontaneous, and more than ever the master of his musical world.

releases.title: Silly Sisters
releases.label: Chrysalis Records
releases.details: June Tabor and Maddy Prior’s 1976 album Silly Sisters is a seminal collaboration in British folk, uniting two of the genre’s most iconic voices–Prior, known for her work with Steeleye Span, and Tabor, renowned for her stark, emotive solo interpretations. The album weaves together traditional British and Celtic ballads (such as „Geordie“ and „The Grey Funnel Line“) with rare gems like „The Seven Joys of Mary,“ showcasing striking vocal interplay and unadorned yet powerful arrangements. Often compared to the harmonies of The Watersons or the narrative depth of Shirley Collins, Silly Sisters remains a touchstone for lovers of traditional song and vocal duet performance. The newly remastered version of Silly Sisters offers a fresh opportunity for new audiences to experience this work. The package comes with new reflections from Maddy Prior and June Tabor. Chrysalis Red Series is a new series offering a deep dive into the forgotten corners of our catalogue. Unearthing overlooked masterpieces, cult classics, and genre-defying oddities that deserve a reappraisal or a proper introduction. Silly Sisters [Chrysalis Red Series]: Available on vinyl for the first time since the original release. Remastered and cut at AIR Mastering and manufactured at Scottish pressing plant Seabass on rose-pink vinyl.

 First time ever vinyl release for this incredible live concert from Rainbow’s debut world tour and documenting one of the band’s first ever shows in Europe, at Cologne’s Kölner Sporthalle on 25th September 1976. Released on 3LP with each disc pressed in a different colour of the Rainbow (Translucent Red, Yellow and Blue) and Newly Mastered by Andy Pearce & Matt Wortham.
 
 When Rainbow finally landed in Europe for their debut live shows there, it was on the back of both the albums ‘Ritchie Blackmore’s Rainbow’ and ‘Rainbow Rising’ having charted, so the band were playing sold out venues, and what a band… with the line up consisting of Ritchie Blackmore, Ronnie James, Cozy Powell, Jimmy Bain and Tony Carey.
 
 As one of the cornerstones of British Rock, Rainbow, led by the never-predictable but ever-astonishing guitarist, Ritchie Blackmore, became synonymous with some of the most well regarded and popular charting Rock songs of the seventies and eighties.
 
 This show recorded on the bands Rainbow Rising tour in 1976 in Cologne Germany, features stone cold classics such as ‘Stargazer’ and ‘Man on the Silver Mountain’. This live album has only been available on CD pressings originally made 20 years ago, both as a single concert / as part of the Japan only 6-CD Box Set Deutschland Tournee 1976. Now nearly 50 years on from the original concert, the recording makes it’s debut appearance on a vinyl format with the audio Newly mastered by Andy Pearce & Matt Wortham.

releases.details: San Francisco-based post-punk/new wave scene band Romeo Void actively toured the world throughout their early 1980s career. This double-LP set compiles some of the band’s best performances from their personal recording archives. Features eighteen tracks from their three studio albums including the alternative radio hits, „Never Say Never“ and „A Girl In Trouble (Is A Temporary Thing) along with fan favorites „Chinatown“, „Instincts“, „White Sweater“ and others. The tracks are compiled from four different dates starting in Albany, New York in 1981, Ann Arbor, Michigan in 1982 and two from their 1985 European tour in Berlin and London. The album is packaged in a gatefold sleeve with rare images from the band’s personal collection of photos and memorabilia. The artwork was designed by band members Deborah Iyall and Frank Zincavage. Both will be available to promote the release for Record Store Day through interviews for media outlets and podcasts.

releases.title: Coming Up at the BBC
releases.label: Demon
releases.details:
*** Never before released on any format! Limited Hot Pink Vinyl! ***
 The landmark 1996 album reconstructed from BBC sessions and live recordings!
 Suede’s commercial high watermark came in 1996 with ‘Coming Up’. The 1995 addition to the line-up of lead guitarist Richard Oakes and keyboard player Neil Codling had given the band a new impetus and focus. At the very pinnacle of ‘Britpop’ – a scene they’d helped inspire but fiercely operated outside of – roared back with an adrenalin rush of new Suede classics. 
 The first missive from ‘Coming Up’ was the trailblazing ‘Trash’, which reached No. 3 in the UK chart – a joint career-best for the band. That was followed into the Top 10 over the next twelve months by four more hit singles from the album – ‘Beautiful Ones’, ‘Lazy’, ‘Saturday Night’, and ‘Filmstar’. 
 During ‘Coming Up’’s album and singles lifespan of more than a year the band toured almost constantly – taking in the USA, Japan, Europe and right across the UK. The culmination of a year’s precision-tooling of the material in the live arena came 22nd August 1997 and a triumphant headlining slot at Reading Festival.
 Collected here are selected recordings from the Reading gig, broadcast on BBC Radio 1, plus some previously unreleased studio takes of the album’s tracks recorded for the station’s Evening Session and Mark Radlcliffe shows. Cherrypicked by the band as the best possible ‘Coming Up’ BBC recordings, they’ve been sequenced for ‘Coming Up At The BBC’ in the same order as the original studio album.
 Note: Because no contemporary or BBC versions of the album’s penultimate song, ‘The Chemistry Between Us’ exists, Suede have kindly donated a previously unreleased 1999 live version recorded by the same line up at that year’s Roskilde Festival.

releases.title: Songs from „Marc“
releases.label: Demon
releases.details:
*** Never before released on any format! Limited ORANGE Vinyl! ***
 Newly unearthed and 100% previously unreleased – the definitive ‘MARC’ show recordings from 1977.
 Marc Bolan’s celebrated 1977 six-part Granada TV series, ‘MARC’, renewed his position as a central force in the UK music scene as he broke new ground hosting his own show.
 During the series Marc, backed by a mostly new T.Rex (Herbie Flowers on bass, Tony Newman on drums with Dino Dines on keyboards), delivered fresh versions of highlights from his stellar career alongside a sprinkling of new songs and well-chosen covers of 1950s classics. It’s unclear whether the 1977-version tracks were recorded in London or Manchester, but it is most likely that T.Rex used a studio in the capital: they were made specifically for the show and Bolan had several studios at his disposal in his hometown. The tape box, unearthed in December 2024, offers no further clue.
 The shows were filmed in Manchester in pairs: Granada’s Studio 6 hosted Marc, his band and many guests over three 48-hour periods. Shows one and two were filmed on 9 and 10 August 1977; three and four on 22 and 23 August, with the final pair captured on 6 and 7 September. Transmission began on Wednesday 24 August at 4.20pm, with the sixth episode screening on 28 September, 12 days after the tragic accident which took Marc’s life.
 The songs on this collection are from shows 1 to 4, recently discovered on a long-lost ¼” tape and newly mastered. Each track is complete: intros, full songs and endings all present and correct, also benefitting from an absence of overdubbed audience noise. (There was no actual audience in the Granada studios.) Of particular note is Hot Love, running to over four minutes with the distinctive vocals of Lynn Garden accompanying Marc on the coda, and Dandy In The Underworld, an instrumental take as the broadcast version featured a live Bolan vocal.The stunning cover shot, taken by Kevin Cummins, captures Marc in action, in the Granada Studios. 
 Almost 50 years after the event, MARC is presented here with better clarity than ever before.

releases.title: DJ KOCO aka SHIMOKITA – Cuban 45 Boxset
releases.label: Mr Bongo Records
releases.details:
Two years since DJ KOCO aka SHIMOKITA curated his sold-out Mr Bongo Brazil 45 boxset, he is back with another Record Store Day special, this time turning his attention to Cuba. Following a meteoric rise to the top, the Japanese DJ / turntablist extraordinaire has won the world over with his unquestionable humility, refreshing positivity, and flawless skills. The DJ’s DJ, it’s as much about taste as it is technicality for one of the world’s best showmen. 
 
 
 
 When the idea arose for a Cuban Classics 45 Boxset to mark RSD 2026, DJ KOCO was top of the list. With a deep-seated passion for Cuban music, its melting pot of cultures, its focus on rhythm, and its undeniable groove, DJ KOCO presents a selection of his favourite Cuban cuts, as well as two exclusive edits for the boxset.
 
 
 
 It kicks off with the Latin funk sounds of Ricardo Eddy Martínez y Expreso Rítmico’s ‘La 132’ from 1978, before rolling into one of two spellbinding Juan Pablo Torres y Algo Nuevo cuts found on the boxset. Elsewhere, you’ll hear Farah María’s slow disco ‘Ámame Y No pienses Mas’, an unusual American-leaning production for Cuba at the time, given the state of US-Cuban political relations in that period. Other highlights include Orquesta Riverside’s ‘En Casa Del Trompo No Bailes’, taken from a rare collectable 7”, channelling a low-slung Latin bounce which explodes into an Afro-Cuban dancer as the track progresses. 
 
 
 
 In signature style, DJ KOCO has also served up two exclusive edits for the boxset. These include a reworking of the Cuban children’s band Grupo Ismaelillo’s quirky ‘Amanecer’, giving it a more DJ-friendly structure. You’ll also find DJ KOCO’s take on FA-5’s much-loved funky dancer ‘Muévete Con Las Fuerzas Del Corazón’ with its heavy b-boy/girl break from 1976. 
 
 
 
 Testament to Cuba’s vast and vibrant musical landscape, DJ KOCO has cherry-picked some of the finest recordings to emanate from the country, spanning a wide range of styles and rhythms. Yet what ties all the tracks on this boxset together, is a hip hop sensibility and thirst for a breaks-heavy, danceable energy which radiates through DJ KOCO’s masterful DJ sets.
 
 
 • The 7” DJ / turntablist maestro from Japan, presents a heavy selection of his favourite Cuban cuts for Record Store Day 2026.
 
 
 
 • Featuring prized tracks from Ricardo Eddy Martínez, Juan Pablo Torres, Grupo Los Yoyi and Farah María + many more alongside two exclusive DJ KOCO aka SHIMOKITA edits.
 
 
 
 • 5 x unique 45s in a limited-edition clamshell box.

Looking to increase their profile in the Northern Hemisphere (where their previous albums had made an impact through the likes of U.S. College Radio), they signed with Los Angeles based Slash Records.
